NAME: Peppe
TEXT: Peppe is a gorgeous, very sweet 2 year old boy, ready for his next step! He’s a sweet, mostly confident, but due to his young age he can take time to process new situations, but he becomes more engaged as he settles. He’s polite with other greyhounds, offering calm sniffs before moving on and could live with another dog his size. He’s fine in the crate with a little encouragement and settles once inside. Peppe is a gentle boy who will thrive with consistency to build confidence and continue developing into a lovely pet. As he is young, he has a whole exciting life ahead of him and he can't wait to meet you! Meet Peppe at Western Sydney.

NAME: Stanley
TEXT: Stanley is lovely, friendly, soft-natured boy who loves to cuddle. He has a quiet nature and just loves to be around you and check out what you're doing as you go about your day - a sticky beak! He is an easy-going, gentle lad who will be your best friend. Stanley is the perfect gentleman and companion for retirees or workers, he doesn't need much of a walk or trips in the car, he's just happy to hang about at home. Stanley isn’t an energetic boy, very easy-care who would make a wonderful pet, also great with the grandchildren 9 and 13 when they come to visit. 🐾💙

NAME: Cheesey
TEXT: Meet Cheesey – Your Loyal, Lovable Sidekick 🐾 Cheesey is a lovely-natured boy with a gentle, caring heart. He absolutely adores kids aged 10–13 and thrives on attention, pats, and plenty of love. When you come home, he’ll greet you with happy excitement, then quickly settle down after pats and play, content just to be by your side. On walks, Cheesey is a dream - once he get sgoing he happily strolls at your pace and enjoys taking in the world with you. After a nice walk and a zoom around the yard or some fun with his toys, he’s more than ready to flop on the floor for a well-earned rest. He’s attentive, loyal, and eager to please, making him a very trainable companion. Cheesey loves splashing in his water bowl or cooling off in a shell pool — he’s got a playful streak and a bit of a cheeky character that will keep you smiling. Importantly, Cheesey is also wonderfully patient and independent. He’s perfectly happy to relax on his own during the day if you’re at work - no fuss, no hassle. Just a steady, easygoing boy waiting for his people to come home. 🐾💙

NAME: Tommy
TEXT: Tommy is a gentle and sweet male greyhound who simply needs a little time to feel safe in new surroundings. When he first arrived, he was understandably nervous and avoidant with staff, but it didn’t take long for his true personality to shine through. Once he settled in, Tommy quickly warmed up and showed himself to be a calm, affectionate, and easy-going boy. One of Tommy’s favourite things is having a cosy crate to retreat to. He happily walks into his crate on his own and settles quickly, making it a comforting and safe space for him. He has also been very clean indoors and has had no toileting accidents so far, showing excellent house manners. Tommy has a playful side too and absolutely loves toys. Whether it’s carrying them around or enjoying some quiet playtime, toys quickly bring out his happy and relaxed nature. Because Tommy is naturally calm once settled, he may suit apartment living and could potentially cope well with longer periods alone. However, as he can initially feel nervous in unfamiliar environments, he will benefit from patient adopters who can give him time to adjust and build confidence at his own pace. With kindness, understanding, and a little patience, Tommy will reward his new family with loyalty, quiet companionship, and plenty of gentle affection. Meet Tommy at Western Sydney.

NAME: Solly
TEXT: Solly is a striking young man with a personality that’s equal parts energetic and laid-back. He thrives on an active lifestyle—think brisk walks, playtime, and the occasional burst of zoomies to burn off his youthful energy. After he’s had his exercise, Solly transforms into a mellow cuddle enthusiast, always ready to relax with a wagging tail and plenty of affection. His gentle nature would likely fit well into a family environment, and he also might be suited for homes with full-time workers as long as he gets his daily dose of activity. If you’re looking for a loyal companion who can keep up on walks and then happily settle down for some quality downtime, Solly might be the perfect match for you!

NAME: Nelly
TEXT: *I am in foster care & available to adopt!* Nelly is a gentle, sensitive soul who is just waiting for the right home to help her truly blossom. While she may be a little shy when meeting new people, once she gets to know you she becomes incredibly sweet, affectionate, and loyal. Nelly is looking for a quiet, calm house or apartment forever home where she can settle into pet life at her own pace. Busy households or lots of noise can feel overwhelming for her, so she would thrive in a peaceful environment with patient adopters who understand that confidence takes time to grow. She has been doing well with consistency in foster care. Because of her sensitive nature, Nelly's ideal home is with an adult-only household or older children aged 16+ with dog experience. She needs a predictable, calm environment to feel safe and secure. She would also really benefit from having a friendly, confident canine companion. A doggy friend could help show her the ropes, build her confidence, and encourage her to relax. Once she feels safe, Nelly settles beautifully indoors and is a huge fan of the couch and resting indoors. Snuggling up for a cozy evening is one of her favorite things! She’s the perfect companion for someone who enjoys quiet nights in, gentle walks, and sharing their home (and sofa!) with a loving best friend. If you have a calm home, a kind heart, and maybe even a friendly resident dog, Nelly could be the perfect addition to your family. Nelly is available via appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Joany
TEXT: Meet Joany, Joany is a beautiful female Greyhound who is truly a sweet bundle of joy. Full of personality and affection, Joany brings happiness wherever she goes with her bouncy nature and loving heart. She absolutely adores attention and loves spending time with her people, happily soaking up pats, affection, and companionship whenever she can. Joany is an affectionate girl who enjoys being involved in everyday life and will quickly charm everyone she meets with her playful and happy personality. Joany is social with large breed dogs and enjoys canine company, making her a lovely companion both at home and out on walks. One of her favourite things is letting loose and doing zoomies, showing off her fun-loving spirit and joyful energy. With her affectionate nature, playful personality, and endless enthusiasm for life, Joany is ready to find a loving home where she can continue spreading happiness, cuddles, and zoomies every day. Book in to meet Joany in Western Sydney.

NAME: Jasper
TEXT: Jasper is a friendly and confident Greyhound who absolutely loves being around people. He thrives on affection and human interaction and is happiest when he’s included in everyday life with his family. Jasper enjoys being part of the action and will happily seek out attention and cuddles from his favourite humans whenever he gets the chance. With his social and outgoing nature, Jasper is a lovely companion to have around the home. He enjoys company and brings a warm, affectionate presence wherever he goes. His confidence and friendly personality make him an easy dog to bond with, and he loves feeling connected to the people around him. Jasper is social with other Greyhounds and would likely enjoy the companionship of another calm canine friend. He would benefit from a home with a secure backyard where he can stretch his legs, relax outdoors, and enjoy time with his family. Sweet, affectionate, and full of personality, Jasper is ready to find a loving home where he can continue being included, adored, and spoiled with all the attention he deserves. Meet Jasper at Western Sydney.

NAME: Rocky
TEXT: *On adoption trial* Meet Rocky! Rocky is a handsome black male Greyhound with a sweet, confident personality and a love for being involved in everyday life. He is an active and curious boy who enjoys exploring his surroundings and taking in the world around him with enthusiasm and confidence. Rocky is social and well-mannered with both big and small dogs, making him a lovely companion out on walks and in social settings. He may also be able to live with cats, provided introductions are slow, thoughtful, and managed carefully to help everyone settle comfortably. He has a gentle and affectionate nature and enjoys spending time with people. Rocky would suit a home with children aged 8 years and older, and his easygoing temperament makes him the kind of dog who could fit beautifully into many different family environments. With his combination of confidence, sweetness, and sociable nature, Rocky is truly a lovely boy who is ready to become a cherished member of a lucky family. He has so much love to give and is sure to bring joy and companionship wherever he goes. Book in to meet Rocky at Western Sydney.

NAME: Uno
TEXT: Meet Sweet Uno, Uno is a unique and sensitive Greyhound looking for a special home that can appreciate him for exactly who he is. He is a quirky boy with a gentle nature who takes a little time to feel safe and comfortable in new environments and around unfamiliar people. While he may initially come across as shy and reserved, Uno begins to show his sweet personality once trust has been built at his own pace. Uno is searching for a calm, patient, and understanding home that can support his individual needs and allow him the time he requires to settle in and gain confidence. He thrives with gentle handling, consistency, and a quiet environment where he feels secure. Because of his sensitive personality, Uno would be best suited to an adult-only household where life is calm and predictable. He is happy to coexist with other Greyhounds and may enjoy the quiet companionship of another calm canine friend. Uno may not be the kind of dog who rushes into new friendships, but for the right person willing to give him time and understanding, he has the potential to form a deeply rewarding bond. He is a truly special boy looking for someone who will see the beauty in his quiet and quirky nature. Find Uno at Western Sydney.

NAME: Vince
TEXT: Vince is a handsome male Greyhound with a confident and easy-going personality. He settles well into new environments and enjoys exploring his surroundings, taking everything in with curiosity and confidence. Whether he’s out on a walk or meeting new people, Vince carries himself with calm and polite manners. He walks beautifully on lead and is a pleasure to have by your side. Vince enjoys human interaction and happily approaches people for attention, often leaning in gently for a scratch and some affection. His friendly and relaxed nature makes him a lovely companion to spend time with. Vince would be best suited as the only animal in the home, where he can enjoy all the love, attention, and comfort for himself. He would thrive in a home that can continue providing him with companionship, routine, and opportunities to explore the world around him. With his confident personality, lovely manners, and affectionate nature, Vince is ready to become a loyal and cherished companion for a very lucky home. Meet Vince at Western Sydney.

NAME: Yanna
TEXT: Meet Yanna, Yanna is a lovely 2-year-old Greyhound with a social and friendly nature. She enjoys being around people and is comfortable with handling, showing a sweet and approachable personality when meeting those around her. Yanna initially presents as a confident young girl who is curious about her environment and enjoys taking in the world around her. As a younger Greyhound, Yanna would benefit from ongoing training and guidance to help her continue building confidence, routine, and positive life skills as she settles into home life. She is eager to learn and would thrive with patient encouragement and consistency. Yanna is polite around other dogs and interacts nicely with them, making her a lovely companion for walks and social outings. She would likely enjoy a home where she has space to stretch her legs and relax, and a house with a secure yard would suit her well. With her friendly personality and gentle nature, Yanna is a beautiful young Greyhound ready to find a home where she can continue to grow and flourish into a wonderful lifelong companion. Book in to meet Yanna at Western Sydney.

NAME: Candy
TEXT: Candy is an affectionate and incredibly sweet girl who wins people over with her beautiful nature and happy personality. She greets her people with excitement and enthusiasm and after a zoom then settles beautifully into relaxed companionship. Candy walks well on leash, is gentle around food and toys, and has shown herself to be a friendly, easy-going girl. She is stair capable and confident around new people. Raised around horses, cows and other hounds, Candy is well accustomed to a variety of animals and environments. She would suit a loving home looking for a loyal friend with an affectionate inquisitive temperament.

NAME: Foxy
TEXT: Foxy is a beautiful 4-year-old light fawn Greyhound with a gentle soul and a sweet personality that shines once she feels safe and comfortable. She can be a little nervous when first meeting new people and may need some extra time and patience to warm up to unfamiliar situations. Once she begins to trust you, Foxy’s soft little tail wag starts to appear, showing her affectionate and loving nature. Foxy is still building her confidence and would benefit from a calm, understanding home that can support her at her own pace. She responds best to gentle handling, kindness, and reassurance while she learns that the world can be a safe and positive place. Because of her sensitive nature, Foxy would be best suited to an adult-only household where she can enjoy a quieter environment and continue growing in confidence without too much pressure or noise around her. She could also happily live with other dogs, and the company of a calm canine companion may help her feel more secure. With patience, love, and understanding, Foxy has the potential to blossom into a wonderfully loyal and affectionate companion. Beneath her shy exterior is a sweet girl just waiting for the right person to help her shine. Book an appointment with Foxy at Western Sydney.

NAME: Bella
TEXT: Meet Bella – Your Beautiful, Water-Loving Companion 💕 Bella is a stunning black Greyhound with a gentle soul and a happy, outgoing personality. She’s the perfect mix of calm relaxation and playful energy, equally content lounging nearby or joining in on family adventures. This lovely girl has a relaxed and easygoing nature in the home, making her a wonderful companion for those quiet moments. But don’t be fooled—Bella also has a fun, energetic side! She enjoys getting out and about and would thrive with an active family who can include her in their daily walks and outings. One of Bella’s most adorable quirks is her love of water—she happily hops into the pool for a refreshing dip on warm days, making her a perfect match for a home that enjoys a splash of fun! Social and well-mannered, Bella gets along beautifully with both small dogs and larger breeds. She has also met children and has enjoyed their company, happily accepting pats and affection. She would be well suited to a home with polite, respectful children. Bella is a confident, friendly girl who loves meeting new people and making friends wherever she goes. Her affectionate nature and bright spirit make her a joy to be around.

NAME: Mighty
TEXT: Meet Mighty! Mighty is a stunning fawn-coloured male Greyhound with a confident, curious personality and a heart to match. This handsome boy loves exploring the world around him and is always investigating new sights and smells with his long nose leading the way. His gentle nature and calm confidence make him a joy to spend time with. When out on walks, Mighty is comfortable around small breed dogs and takes everything in stride with calm curiosity. He approaches life with a relaxed attitude and a sweet, affectionate nature that makes him easy to fall in love with. Mighty is truly a gentle, lovely boy who is ready to find a home where he can continue to grow in confidence, enjoy new experiences, and become a cherished companion. With his handsome looks and beautiful temperament, he is sure to make a wonderful addition to a lucky family. Meet Mighty by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Red (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Meet Red! Red is a handsome male Greyhound with a confident and gentle nature that makes him an easy dog to love. He enjoys being around people and carries himself with calm, polite manners in the home and out in public. Red is the kind of dog who enjoys simply being part of the family. He is social and well-mannered around other Greyhounds and is happy to interact with small dogs when out and about. Red approaches new situations and people with confidence, making him a relaxed and enjoyable companion to spend time with. Because of his calm temperament and confident nature when meeting new people, Red would be best suited to a home with children aged 12 years and older. He would thrive in a home where he can enjoy companionship, gentle affection, and a comfortable place to relax after his daily walks and adventures. Meet Red by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Bear
TEXT: Bear is a beautiful 3-year-old Greyhound with a calm, gentle nature. Bear is social around other dogs and could happily live with other Greyhounds or medium-sized dogs. He may also be able to live with smaller breed dogs if the match is right and introductions are handled slowly and thoughtfully. He walks very well on lead and enjoys getting out for daily strolls before returning home for a long nap and some quiet time with his family. A home with older children would suit Bear best, as he would appreciate a calm and respectful environment where he can feel comfortable and settled. He would also love a home with a secure backyard where he can stretch his legs, relax in the sunshine, and enjoy some outdoor time. Bear is a sweet, adaptable boy who has so much love to give. With his gentle temperament and lovely manners, he is ready to become a cherished member of a lucky family. Meet Bear by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Boof
TEXT: Boof is a big-hearted boy with an even bigger personality to match. A true “boof head” in every sense of the word, he’s playful, affectionate, and always ready to brighten your day with his goofy charm. This sweet soul enjoys connection, leaning his whole weight into you for a cuddle (greyhound-style hugs are his specialty!). He’s just as happy hanging out with fellow dogs, he loves a good play session and enjoys their company enormously. Boof’s gentle nature and affectionate demeanor make him an all-round delight to have around. He’s the kind of dog who will make you laugh with his antics one moment, then melt your heart the next with his soft gaze and signature lean. If you’re looking for a loyal, loving companion with a playful spirit and a whole lot of personality, Boof is your boy — a true boof head and proud of it! 💛

NAME: Flossy
TEXT: Flossy is a sweet and gentle greyhound who is looking for a calm, understanding home where she can continue building her confidence at her own pace. She has a soft nature and enjoys spending time with people, often seeking reassurance and quiet companionship from those around her. She walks nicely on lead and enjoys calmly exploring her surroundings, taking everything in with curiosity. While Flossy can be a little unsure in new situations at first, she settles best with patient guidance, predictable routines, and a supportive environment where she feels safe and secure. Flossy gets along well with other greyhounds and would enjoy a relaxed lifestyle with plenty of opportunities to rest, explore, and bond with her new family. She would likely suit a quieter home environment and shorter periods alone while she adjusts to pet life and learns new routines. Due to her level of interest in smaller animals, Flossy is best suited to a home without cats or small pets. Flossy has a kind and affectionate personality and will make a lovely companion for adopters willing to give her a little time and support as she settles into home life. Meet Flossy at Western Sydney!

NAME: Noel
TEXT: Meet Noel 🐾 Noel is a true gentle giant with a heart as big as his long, lanky legs. This handsome boy is incredibly social and has quickly become a crowd favourite thanks to his friendly nature and easy-going personality. He loves meeting new people and is always happy to soak up plenty of pats and attention. Cool, calm, and collected, Noel takes most things in life in his stride. Whether it’s hopping into the car or even enjoying a train ride, he handles new experiences with confidence and ease, making him a wonderful companion for a variety of lifestyles. But every hero has their kryptonite—and for Noel, it’s stuffed toys! The moment he spots one, it’s game on, and his playful, determined side comes to life. It’s all business when a soft toy is involved, and it’s sure to bring a smile to your face. Noel would thrive in a home where he can be part of the action, surrounded by people who will give him the love and attention he adores. If you’re looking for a sociable, affectionate, and entertaining companion with a playful streak, Noel might just be your perfect match. 💙

NAME: Missy
TEXT: Meet Missy 🐾 Missy is a gentle, affectionate greyhound with a heart full of love and a calm, easy-going nature. She absolutely adores being around her people and will happily spend her days close by your side, whether that’s relaxing at home or enjoying a quiet outing together. Like many greyhounds, Missy has mastered the art of comfort—her bed is one of her favourite places, and she’s happiest when she can stretch out and enjoy a good snooze after some quality time with her humans. Missy has already shown her adaptable and easy-going personality by taking a train ride in her stride, proving she’s a lovely companion both at home and when out and about. She would thrive in a home where she can be part of the family and spend plenty of time with her people. Missy would also love the company of another friendly greyhound, or a calm medium-to-large breed dog, to share her days with. If you’re looking for a sweet, gentle companion who will bring warmth, quiet companionship, and plenty of love into your life, Missy could be the perfect match. 💛

NAME: Jasper (Western Sydney)
TEXT: *I have just gone to foster care!* Jasper is your quintessential low maintenance kinda guy, playful, but shy, and can take time to warm up. An owner who enjoys helping a shy greyhound come out of their shell is the best fit for Jasper. He likes slow adventures, where he can take things in at his own pace. He likes his quiet time and down time, and enjoys settling down when things are chill, and will go to his crate when he wants some time out. A house with a yard, in a quiet part of town, with a low dog population when out and about would suit Jasper perfectly as he can become overwhelmed with too much happening out and about. He loves all things food and puzzle enrichment, so a home that will provide ongoing mental stimulation in lieu of walkies and adventures will be Jaspers best match. Jasper is polite with other dogs his size at the adoption centre, and could live with one, however not a requirement. Meet Jasper at Western Sydney.

NAME: Silver
TEXT: Meet Silver✨ Just like his name, Silver has a stunning silverish coat that truly makes him stand out from the crowd. Paired with his calm and easy-going nature, this handsome boy is as lovely on the inside as he is on the outside. Silver enjoys a pat and spending time with his people, but he’s also more than happy to relax on his own and enjoy a peaceful snooze. With his chilled personality and gentle nature, he would make a beautiful companion for someone looking for a laid-back best friend. Even better, Silver gets along well with small dogs too!

NAME: Azzi
TEXT: 🤍 Meet Azzi Azzi is a beautiful older gentleman with the sweetest soul and a gentle nature that’s impossible not to love. He’s calm, affectionate and happiest simply spending time with his people, making him the perfect loyal companion to share your days with. Great with small dogs, Azzi has a kind and easy-going personality that would suit a home looking for a relaxed best friend. With his soft eyes and loving nature, this lovely boy is ready to enjoy the retired life full of comfort, companionship and plenty of love.

NAME: Indie
TEXT: Meet Indie 🌸 Indie is a beautiful quiet girl with a gentle nature and kind soul. While she may take a little time to feel comfortable in new surroundings, once she trusts you her sweet personality really begins to shine. She’s the kind of girl who will form a special bond with her people and happily keep you company by your side. With her calm presence and soft nature, Indi would love a patient home where she can settle in at her own pace and grow into the loyal best friend she’s meant to be.

NAME: Millie
TEXT: Meet Millie! 🐾 With her adorable floppy ears and playful personality, Millie is sure to make you smile. She absolutely loves her toys and enjoys a good play, bringing plenty of happy energy wherever she goes. Behind her cheeky side is a sweet girl who, with a little time to settle in, will become your loyal little bestie.

NAME: Mia
TEXT: Meet Mia - a calm, confident and affectionate girl who has been happily living as part of the family, sharing her space with other greyhounds and enjoying the comforts of indoor life, too - especially naps on the couch and a 7-year-old’s bed! She is a relaxed, friendly girl who absolutely loves attention and a good pat. Easy to walk and a pleasure to have around, Mia enjoys her daily strolls, outdoor time and playing with her toys. She has also been introduced to labradors and even a cat, taking it all in her stride without concern. Mia would make a wonderful family companion. She is used to children, other pets, and spending most of her day happily lounging around and relaxing. If you’re a couple or single looking for an easy-going friend or a retiree wanting a loving companion, Mia could also be the perfect fit.

NAME: Snowy Rules
TEXT: Snowy truly lives up to her name — a gorgeous, active girl with a huge zest for life and a love for adventure. Whether she’s zooming around the yard, splashing in the dam, or exploring the outdoors, Snowy thrives in an environment where she can stretch her legs and enjoy an active lifestyle. Raised on a property, Snowy has experience around a wide variety of dogs and gets along beautifully with all shapes and sizes, from tiny whippets and fluffy groodles through to fellow hounds. She’s also great with children, making her a wonderful option for a fun-loving family home. A true water baby at heart, Snowy’s favorite days are spent swimming, running, and soaking up the outdoors before settling down with her people. She would love a home that can continue giving her plenty of exercise, enrichment, and adventures to keep her happy and thriving. With her stunning looks, friendly personality, and energetic spirit, Snowy is ready to become someone’s perfect active companion.

NAME: Jake
TEXT: Jake, also known as “Taw Commander,” is a striking young boy bursting with personality, enthusiasm, and charm. Extremely social with people, Jake thrives on human interaction and forms strong bonds with his handlers, listening well and loving being part of the action. A playful and energetic lad, Jake would suit an active home that can keep up with his zest for life. While he absolutely adores playtime, he can be a little unaware of his own size and strength, so he would be best matched with medium to large canine companions. He’s already proven himself capable of making great doggy friendships — his best mate is a Rottweiler! Jake has been acclimated to life inside the home and is looking for a family who will include him in their daily adventures, whether that’s walks, outings, or relaxing together after a fun-filled day. With his stunning looks, affectionate nature, and larger-than-life personality, Jake is sure to make an unforgettable companion.

NAME: Emma
TEXT: Emma is a little in size and big on personality! She is bright, fun-loving and an affectionate. She thrives around people and is incredibly friendly with medium to large dogs, often enjoying their company so much that she would likely love a canine companion in her future home. Because Emma can get a little enthusiastic and excitable during play, any dog friend would need to be tolerant and easy-going. While she can be energetic, Emma also settles beautifully indoors once she has had the chance to exercise and unwind making her suitable for apartment living with an active lifestyle. Some hours alone are suitable as a solo pet but an outlet for enrichment and stimulation is best suited. Due to her lively nature, she would be best suited to older klds. Meet Emma at Western Sydney.

NAME: Arlo
TEXT: Arlo is an affectionate boy with a beautiful brindle coat. He’s a soft, social soul who adores being around people and thrives on gentle attention. At almost two years old, he’s in that perfect stage—playful and curious but already calm and well‑mannered. This sweet boy has a patient, gentle nature that makes him well-suited to families with children. He enjoys being involved in family life and loves soaking up pats, ear scratches, and cuddles from little humans. He also loves to play with other medium to large dogs. 🏡 Ideal Home Arlo would thrive in a home that: Enjoys daily walks, playtime, and plenty of affection Understands the needs of a young greyhound—soft beds, gentle routines, and occasional goofy antics ❤️ Why You’ll Love Him Arlo is all heart. He’s the kind of dog who bonds deeply, follows you with those big soulful eyes. Whether he’s snoozing in the sun, trotting happily beside a dog buddy, or leaning in for a cuddle, Arlo brings warmth and joy everywhere he goes.

NAME: Foxy
TEXT: Foxy is a happy, playful and handsome blue boy with a big heart and an even bigger love for pats and cuddles. He enjoys his walks and is great on the lead, making him a lovely companion for an active family. Foxy has spent time both indoors and outdoors and been around the family children aged 9 and 12 years daily, as well as the 2.5-year-old under supervision. He’s friendly and social with other dogs too, getting along well with a pet dachshund, a pointer, and other greyhounds. Tigress has been his yard mate. With his affectionate nature, playful personality, and easy-going temperament, Foxy would suit a family looking for a fun, loving companion to include in everyday life.

NAME: Red
TEXT: Meet Red ❤️ Say hello to Red – a tender-hearted boy with a sweet soul and the most soulful eyes you’ve ever seen. Red may be a little reserved at first, but once he feels safe and settled, he shows his loving personality in the most heartwarming ways. Red is great with other greyhounds and enjoys their calm, familiar company. He’s also been around smaller dogs – he just may need a slower, thoughtful introduction to build his comfort and confidence. With the right introductions and guidance, he’s more than happy to share his space with gentle doggy friends. Red has been around children in a home environment and handles it well with his naturally gentle nature. However, due to his shy disposition, a quieter home – perhaps with older, dog-savvy kids – would be the best match for him. He thrives in calm, predictable spaces where he can truly feel at ease. Red can be a bit nervous when meeting new people or exploring new situations, but give him time and patience, and you’ll be rewarded with the trust and love of a truly special dog. He prefers to interact on his own terms – not pushy or demanding, just quietly curious and kind. Red enjoys his peaceful moments, lounging nearby, quietly observing, and choosing when to come over for a little affection or company. His independence, mixed with his loving nature, makes him a calm and comforting presence in the home. Red would thrive in a gentle, patient home where he can settle in at his own pace and build trust with his new family. He doesn’t ask for much – just kindness, understanding, and a safe space where he can be himself. In return, you’ll get a loyal, loving companion with the sweetest heart.

NAME: Pablo
TEXT: Pablo is a beautifully relaxed and gentle companion with a calm nature that makes him a joy to spend time with. Whether he’s out on a walk or relaxing quietly at home, he carries himself with patience, ease, and an easygoing confidence that instantly makes people feel comfortable around him. One of Pablo’s greatest loves in life is toys. He absolutely adores playing, especially a fun game of fetch, and happily joins in whenever there’s an opportunity for playtime. His playful side is balanced perfectly by his calm temperament, making him just as content to settle independently and enjoy peaceful moments once the excitement is over. Pablo would thrive best in a home where he can be the sole animal or with a medium to large breed dog and receive all of the love and attention. He truly enjoys human company and forms lovely connections with the people around him. Meet Pablo in Western Sydney.

NAME: Louie
TEXT: Louie is a gentle, low maintenance, laid back and quiet soul. If you're looking for a laid back senior greyhound, Louie might be perfect for you. Louie enjoys life in the slow lane and is looking for someone to spend quiet time with. Louie is a lovely greyhound who loves mingling with other dogs his size, settles well alone and would love a home with indoor outdoor access where he can independently alternate between exploring outside and resting on beds indoors. A solo pet home is best suited. He is suitable with older/respectful kids and dreams of a backyard/courtyard to snooze in. He would like a flat home without stairs, as he is still learning how to navigate staircases. Louie is a sweet gentleman and he hopes you come to meet him soon. Meet Louie at Western Sydney.

NAME: Autumn
TEXT: *I have just gone into a foster home - stay tuned for updates* Gorgeous red fawn girl Autumn is looking for her forever home! Autumn is a playful, affectionate girl well suited to fun-loving adopters! She absolutely loves playing with her squeaky toys, going for short sniffari-style walks and wriggling her way on to your lap for snuggles! Autumn is well behaved indoors and doesn't mind spending a few hours alone during the day, making her a good match for apartment/unit (no stairs please!) dwellers who are looking for a companion to spend time with after work. She would also suit respectful kids who enjoy a fun, sweet dog. She is more of a people dog and would prefer not to share her new home with other animals. She would like all the love and attention for herself! Beautiful Autumn will love you for more than just the season - she will be your bestie for life! Apply online to take her home.

NAME: Tokyo
TEXT: Tokyo is a stunning girl with a gentle soul. Initially shy, once she learns to trust you she forms a beautiful bond and looks to her favourite person for comfort and companionship. She loves stretching her legs and zooming around open spaces, but is equally happy curling up on the couch for a peaceful afternoon. Tokyo would thrive in a calm, quiet home with someone patient enough to let her blossom at her own pace. In return, she’ll reward you with loyalty, affection, and her striking good looks.

NAME: Rusty (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Rusty is a gentle soul with a quiet nature and a heart that slowly but surely opens once he feels safe and comfortable. He may take a little time to warm up to new people, but he is making wonderful progress with meeting strangers. Once he settles into his home, Rusty becomes the ultimate companion. He loves being near his people and will happily follow you from room to room like your own loyal shadow. He forms strong bonds with those he trusts and enjoys sharing calm moments together, especially when food is involved. Rusty’s love of snacks definitely shines through once he feels relaxed and confident around you. Rusty would thrive in a calm and predictable household with older children who can respect his gentle nature and give him the space he needs while settling in. He would also benefit from living with a calm large breed dog or another greyhound, as the company of a steady canine friend helps him feel more secure and confident. Behind his quiet exterior is a sweet, affectionate boy who simply wants to feel safe, loved, and included. For the right home, Rusty will become a devoted and loving companion who will be by your side every step of the way. Meet Rusty in Western Sydney.

NAME: Eddy
TEXT: Eddy is a sweet, gentle and quiet boy looking for a family to thrive in. He might be going a little grey in the face but he is full of cuddles, life and happiness and can't wait to have a family to share his life with. He warms up with those he's confident with and would do best with a backyard/courtyard for sunbaking and sniffing the breeze with the occasional zoomie. He would suit a home with respectful/quiet kids and even a doggie friend or two! Eddy hasn't seen a lot of the world yet and would thrive with a home who is looking to show him all things pet life. He is very eager to please, friendly and sweet... Eddy can't wait to meet you and become a beloved family pet! Eddy is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Choppy
TEXT: Choppy has been in a foster care home, they say he is "one of the sweetest boys you will ever meet". The say he is goofy, loves squeaky toys, and that play is his love language. He will bounce a ball before you throw it, show off his helicopter tail and he will never say no to a good pat, and will be friendly to everyone he meets" He's social, loves food and walks lovely on the lead too making you forget he is a large breed dog. He has shown to be OK in a crate too. A house with a yard/courtyard, some hours alone as a solo dog or a home with a dog friend/s would be a great fit. He's friendly and seeks attention, so shorter hours alone while he first settles in would suit best. Choppy would love a home with kids who can play with him, someone home to keep him company or another dog, but can do longer stretches of alone time when needed as seen in foster. He's learnt things like heel, stop, waiting for meals, toilet training and in home manners. He is a gentleman through and through. Choppy is at Western Sydney.

NAME: Ellie (Western Sydney)
TEXT: I have just finished up my foster care time! Read my foster update: "She was very shy at first & took to me quite quickly. It’s taking a little longer with others though. Ellie loves her walks in the mornings & afternoons & loves her toys, treats & new bed. We have started work on coming when she is called which she does do sometimes. Ellie is a beautiful, gentle girl who loves doing short zoomies in the backyard, walks in the mornings & afternoons and being with you for the rest of the day. She is also toilet trained and ok to stay in the yard on her own all day if necessary. She will make a great companion for her adoptive family." Ellie loves her treats and her toys and we have found it to be a super rewarding experience to win her over! She may even delight you with her spontaneous joyful zoomies (that last approximately 7 seconds before she needs a nap). Ellie would suit a relaxed and laid back home and lifestyle and would love a backyard or courtyard to call her own. She is happy to share her home with another big or small dog, or could spend a few hours chilling alone during the day as a single dog. In foster she could be left for multiple hours. Older, respectful kids/teens are suitable, provided they can give Ellie space when she needs a break. If you think you can give Ellie the loving home she deserves, apply online today to adopt this sweet girl! Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Warren
TEXT: Meet Warren 🐾 The lovable goofball who’s guaranteed to steal your heart and keep you laughing along the way. This happy boy loves a play, enjoys being by your side, and is just as content stretching out for a big snooze afterwards. With his fun personality and easy-going nature, Warren is the perfect mix of playful best mate and laid-back companion.

NAME: Jackson
TEXT: Meet Jackson🐾 A joyful boy with a big personality and an even bigger smile! Full of life and always ready to brighten your day, Jackson has a fun-loving nature that will keep you smiling. Whether he’s being goofy, bouncing around happily, or just enjoying the moment by your side, this sweet guy brings a whole lot of happiness wherever he goes.

NAME: Mumbles
TEXT: Meet Mumbles 😄 A happy, friendly boy with the funniest personality and plenty of charm. While he loves being around his people and making you smile with his goofy nature, he’s just as happy relaxing by your side and enjoying the quieter moments too. Mumbles is the perfect mix of fun companion and goofy best friend.

NAME: Freddy
TEXT: Meet Freddy 😄 The fun-loving goofball guaranteed to keep you smiling. With his cheeky personality and playful nature, Freddy loves being by your side and getting involved in whatever you’re doing. Whether he’s making you laugh with his silly antics or soaking up attention from his humans, this happy boy brings plenty of personality wherever he goes. Freddy is the kind of companion who will quickly become your shadow and your daily dose of entertainment.

NAME: Chubbs
TEXT: Meet Chubbs 💙 Chubbs is a gentle soul with a beautiful smile and an even sweeter personality to match. This lovely boy is happiest simply being by your side, whether it’s joining you for a stroll, relaxing at home, or soaking up affection from his humans. With his calm nature and companionable personality, Chubbs is the kind of dog who will quickly become your loyal best friend.

NAME: Fran
TEXT: Fran is a lovely dynamic girl. She enjoys playing and just being your company. She loves a treat, she loves to stretch out to start the day and then she is happy to lounge around for the rest of the day. She gets on well with dogs of all shapes and sizes. She also shows signs of being cat workable.

NAME: Blue (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Blue is a uniquely patterned white and blue boy, who is gentle in his middle age. Blue is laid back, travels well, settles calmly, who has an overall charming and relaxed manner. On lead, he walks nicely without pulling, and can be shy around new people but likes to take treats and slowly warm up to you. Older kids with dog experience would be best suited. Blue is good with other dogs, showing relaxed body language and polite greetings with medium to large dogs. His favourite breed is Labradors! Overall, Blue is a kind, polite greyhound who will thrive in a quiet, understanding home where he can continue to build confidence and settle into a relaxed routine. Blue is available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Achilles
TEXT: Meet Achilles Achilles is a fun-loving boy who brings the perfect mix of playful energy and laid-back charm 💙 He loves soaking up pats, spending time with his people and having a bit of fun, but he’s just as happy stretching out for a nap and enjoying the quiet life afterwards. With his sweet nature and easy-going personality, Achilles would make a wonderful companion and could also live with small dogs.

NAME: Eleanor
TEXT: Eleanor is a beautiful 5-year-old black greyhound with a fun personality. Known for her sweet nature and playful spirit, she brings a perfect balance of calm affection and bursts of joyful energy to every day. Don’t be fooled by her graceful, elegant appearance Eleanor loves to play! Whether she’s zooming around the yard in classic greyhound fashion or chasing after her favourite toy, her playful side shines through in the most delightful ways. She has a happy, light-hearted energy that’s impossible not to smile at. At heart, though, Eleanor is a sweetheart. She enjoys quiet moments just as much as playtime, happily leaning in for pats, cuddles, and companionship. Her gentle temperament makes her a wonderful friend, and she connects easily with people through her calm, loving presence. Eleanor is the kind of dog who brightens a room simply by being in it—playful when it’s time for fun, and soft and affectionate when it’s time to unwind. A true greyhound gem. 💫

NAME: Umar
TEXT: Umar is a confident and outgoing greyhound with a fun-loving personality and a zest for life. He enjoys being part of the action and is always eager to explore his surroundings, making him a wonderful companion for an active household. As a strong and enthusiastic walker, Umar will benefit from a family who can continue guiding him on lead and enjoy getting out and about with him. He thrives in environments where he has space to move, so a home with secure yard access would suit him perfectly. Whether he’s stretching his legs outdoors or taking in the world around him, Umar enjoys keeping busy and being involved in daily life. Umar is social and comfortable around people, happily spending time alongside his humans, although he tends to show his affection in a more independent and relaxed way. He enjoys companionship without being overly demanding and would suit a home that appreciates his easy-going nature. With his bright personality, confident outlook, and active spirit, Umar is looking for a home that will enjoy all the wonderful qualities he has to offer while giving him the space and lifestyle where he can truly thrive. You can meet Umar in Western Sydney.

NAME: Alvin
TEXT: Alvin is a gentle and sensitive greyhound looking for a quiet and calm household where he can relax and feel safe. With his quiet nature and sweet personality, Alvin would thrive in a peaceful household with a family who appreciates the softer side of life. He would be best suited to a home with a secure yard where he can stretch his legs, lounge in the sunshine, and enjoy his own space. Alvin enjoys relaxing and is happiest in an environment that is calm and predictable. While Alvin can be a little shy when meeting new people, with patience and kindness he gradually warms up and shows his affectionate and gentle nature. He is a quiet, timid boy initially, but once he feels comfortable, he becomes a lovely companion who enjoys simply being near his people. Because Alvin can be shy around young children, he would be best matched with a household with older children or adults only. A quieter home environment will help him continue to build confidence and feel secure. If you are looking for a calm, sweet-natured companion who enjoys a relaxed lifestyle and just needs a little time to blossom, Alvin could be the perfect addition to your family. Alvin is at Western Sydney.

NAME: Tina
TEXT: Tina, named after Tina Turner is a lovely, friendly and sociable young lass looking for her new best friend. She is extroverted and loves people as well as other dogs and has been raised around other hounds and people of all ages. She has proven herself to be calm and polite in the presence of a zooming whippet and shown a love for learning new things and a curious streak. She is a foodie and will do anything for a tasty treat. She is happy to cuddle all day and would love to adventure with her new family.

NAME: Ella
TEXT: Ella is a sweet and playful greyhound with a gentle, loving nature. She has a beautiful temperament and quickly wins hearts with her friendly personality and happy spirit. Whether she’s enjoying a burst of playtime or relaxing by your side, Ella is the perfect mix of fun and calm companionship. One of Ella’s standout qualities is how well she gets along with others. She is wonderfully social and is comfortable around both dogs and cats, making her an excellent fit for a multi-pet household. Her easygoing nature means she settles in quickly and forms strong bonds with both people and furry friends alike. Ella would thrive in a home where she can share her affectionate personality, enjoy regular play, and be part of everyday life. If you’re looking for a gentle, playful companion who brings warmth and joy wherever she goes, Ella could be the perfect addition to your family. 💛

NAME: Dua
TEXT: Meet Dua — a sweet, sensitive soul with a goofy streak that will keep you smiling every day. Initially a little shy, Dua quickly shows her true colours once she feels safe: affectionate, funny, playful, and always ready for a cuddle with her favourite human. Too slow for the racing world but perfectly suited to family life, Dua still loves to zoom around the yard and entertain everyone with her silly energy and lovable personality. She enjoys exploring new environments with a trusted companion by her side and is a very clever girl who likes to keep herself busy. Dua is searching for a calm, quiet home where she can truly relax and enjoy the simple things in life. She would thrive with another calm dog for company and companionship. Due to her impressive problem-solving skills and history of finding creative escape routes just to visit her hound friends, Dua will require a secure, fully fenced yard. If you’re looking for a loyal best friend who will make you laugh, snuggle close on the couch, and bring endless love into your life, Dua may just be your perfect match.

NAME: Kane Conquest
TEXT: Meet Kane — a striking brindle boy with a huge heart and an even bigger love for people. This energetic sweetheart is all about attention, affection, and being close to his humans. Whether he’s splashing around in the water, happily settling into his crate for a car ride, or recalling enthusiastically to his name, Kane is eager to be involved in whatever you’re doing. Kane would thrive with an owner who can continue guiding him with structure and consistency. He’s best suited to an adult-only, single-dog home where he can soak up all the love and attention for himself. While he’s shown calm and appropriate interest through a small fence with a puppy, he’s happiest as the center of someone’s world. He takes food gently, travels well, and has an affectionate, soft nature that quickly wins people over. Kane is an absolute lover who just wants connection and companionship. If you’re looking for a loyal best mate with personality, affection, and a zest for life, Kane could be your perfect match.

NAME: Charlie
TEXT: Charlie is a sweet, dog social boy with a sweet personality to match his handsome looks. His happy personality is hard not to fall in love with, and he would suit a home with respectful kids. He lights up every room he enters with his infectious energy and signature grin. Whether he’s heading out for a walk, playing with his favourite toys, or simply soaking up attention, Charlie approaches life with enthusiasm and charm. Charlie enjoys having company around him and would love a home where he can be part of the daily routine and included in family life. One of Charlie’s greatest joys is playtime, especially when squeaky toys are involved. With his good looks, playful spirit, and affectionate nature, he’s sure to make a wonderful addition to a lucky family. Meet Charlie at Western Sydney.

NAME: Henry
TEXT: Henry is a confident, goofy greyhound with a big personality and an even bigger love for people and has spent time around children and small dogs. He’s friendly, affectionate, and always keen for pats, sniffy walks, and hanging out with his humans. He travels beautifully in the car, settles calmly in a crate, and is generally an easy-going lad. Henry absolutely LOVES other greyhounds and would suit a playful dog companion, big or small. He’s social, gentle and full of cheeky charm. Henry is ready to find a home full of comfy couches, snacks, and a family to adore him. Meet Henry at Western Sydney.

NAME: Eve
TEXT: Eve is a bright, sweet girl with a big personality and an ever-bigger zest for life! She’s the kind of girl who brings energy and joy wherever she goes, always ready for a game, an adventure, or simply some attention from her people. Eve is very social with other dogs and especially enjoys playing with larger breeds and fellow greyhounds. While she can live alongside smaller dogs, she will need calm and slow introductions to help her settle and build confidence around them. Once comfortable, she adjusts well and enjoys having canine company. Having previously lived around small children, Eve would happily suit a family home and has a lovely, friendly nature that makes her easy to adore. She’s also incredibly food motivated, which makes training both rewarding and entertaining (especially if snacks are involved). Whether she’s zooming around with a toy, leaning in for affection, or eagerly waiting for her next treat, Eve approaches life with enthusiasm and sweetness. Eve is simply a lovely girl to be around! She's affectionate, playful, and full of personality. She’s ready to bring laughter, love, and plenty of entertainment to a very lucky home. Meet Eve by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Bolt
TEXT: Bolt is a gentle, sweet-natured greyhound with a soft soul and plenty of love to give. While he can be a little reserved when first meeting new people, it doesn’t take long for his affectionate side to come through once he feels comfortable. He’s the kind of dog who builds strong bonds with his people and absolutely blossoms in a calm, supportive environment. He would thrive in a home with a calm medium to large breed dog to keep him company and to build his confidence. Bolt is wonderful to walk and has lovely lead manners, making outings together an easy and enjoyable part of the day. He would be happiest in a home with older children who can respect his gentle nature and give him the space he needs to settle in at his own pace. For someone willing to give him a little time and reassurance, Bolt will reward them with trust, loyalty, and the quiet kind of love that feels extra special because it’s earned. Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Russell
TEXT: Russell is a friendly, laid-back, and easy-going boy who’s ready to find his forever home. He loves people and has a gentle, affectionate nature that makes him a joy to be around. He’s been wonderful with the household children aged 3 and 7, showing patience and kindness in every interaction. Russell also gets along beautifully with other dogs. He enjoys playtime in the backyard with a Whippet cross and is equally happy socialising with other greyhounds. Whether it’s a relaxed stroll, a bit of play, lounging by your side or in the yard when you're out, Russell is an easy-care companion. He has been living as a pet in the backyard and inside, where he enjoys hopping up on the lounge for a nap or watching some TV when you're home. If you’re looking for a calm, loving dog who would easily into a family or any household life, Russell would be a great match. 💛

NAME: Em-Jay
TEXT: Meet Em-Jay - a happy, smoochy boy with a gentle nature and a love for ear scratches and pats. He enjoys a good run around the backyard, but he’s mostly a quiet, easygoing companion who’s happiest relaxing nearby, playing in his shell pool, or simply enjoying the day with his people. Em-Jay loves his street walks and takes in the world at his own pace. He can be a little shy when meeting new people, but once he gets to know you, he’s very happy to soak up affection and attention. Having lived a quiet life in a rural town, Em-Jay would suit a calm home where he can enjoy companionship, downtime, and being part of everyday life - whether that’s gardening, pottering around the yard, or relaxing at home together. He’s happy as an only dog or could live with a calm female dog, such as a Whippet. With his sweet nature, loving smooches, and gentle companionship, Em-Jay is ready to find a home where he can truly belong.

NAME: Jenny
TEXT: Meet Jenny - a sweet, gentle girl who loves being around people and has a calm, affectionate nature that makes her an easy companion to have by your side. She enjoys car trips, leisurely strolls and walks beautifully on lead, making outings together relaxed and enjoyable. Jenny is well suited to most households and gets along well with children aged 6+, small dogs, cats, and other greyhounds. She has inside living experience and comes with housetraining and crate training already established, making her an easy addition to the home. This lovely girl is low maintenance with short bursts of playful energy. She enjoys toys, responds to her name, and is happiest spending time with her people and relaxing around other dogs. If you’re looking for an easy-care, loving companion with a gentle soul, Jenny could be the perfect match.

NAME: Kermit
TEXT: Meet Kermit — a loving and affectionate grey with a big personality and an adventurous spirit. Kermit loves exploring the world around him and would thrive with a family who enjoys an active lifestyle and can include him in plenty of fun and daily activities. Curious, social, and full of enthusiasm, he’s always ready to see what’s happening next. Kermit is incredibly people-focused and absolutely adores affection. He can get a little over the top with his excitement, often jumping up for cuddles, kisses, and attention because he simply loves being close to his humans. His playful and affectionate nature makes him a wonderfully entertaining companion who brings plenty of energy and joy into a home. Because of his enthusiastic personality and lively approach to affection, Kermit would be best suited to a family or active household rather than an older adopter. With the right home, he’ll make a loyal, fun-loving companion who will happily shower his people with love every single day.

NAME: Chewy
TEXT: Meet Chewy — a confident and engaging grey who navigates the world with calm curiosity and an easygoing nature. Chewy enjoys taking in her surroundings and approaches new experiences with quiet confidence, making her a relaxed and enjoyable companion to have by your side. She’s a social girl who likes being involved in family life and forms lovely connections with the people around her. Whether she’s joining in on daily activities, exploring the backyard, or simply relaxing close to her family, Chewy brings a calm and steady presence wherever she goes. Chewy would be well suited to a family home with a yard where she can enjoy space to wander, explore, and unwind. With her confident temperament, gentle curiosity, and engaging personality, Chewy is sure to make a wonderful companion for a family looking for a loyal and easygoing grey to share life with.

NAME: Pablo
TEXT: Meet Pablo — an energetic bundle of joy bursting with personality and guaranteed to keep life fun and entertaining. This very cool grey has a big zest for life and loves being involved in whatever is happening around him. Whether he’s zooming around the yard, enjoying playtime, or soaking up attention from his people, Pablo brings enthusiasm and happiness everywhere he goes. Pablo absolutely adores cuddles just as much as he loves to play, giving him the perfect mix of affectionate companion and playful best friend. He thrives on interaction and enjoys spending quality time with his family, making him a wonderful dog for an active household that can match his fun-loving spirit. With his lively personality and energetic nature, Pablo would be best suited to a family lifestyle with a good-sized yard where he can stretch his legs, play, and enjoy regular activity. Full of charm, affection, and character, Pablo is the kind of grey who leaves a lasting impression and will bring endless love and laughter to his forever home.

NAME: Jane
TEXT: Meet Jane — a shy but absolutely adorable girl with a gentle nature and a calm, sweet personality. While she may take a little time to feel comfortable in new surroundings, Jane has all the makings of a loving and loyal companion for a family willing to give her patience, kindness, and reassurance. Jane is a very chilled girl who enjoys a peaceful environment and would thrive in a home where she can settle in at her own pace and gradually build confidence. With a loving and caring family by her side, she is sure to blossom and show more of her affectionate personality as she learns to feel safe and secure. Her relaxed and easygoing temperament makes her well suited to a variety of living situations, whether that’s a house with a yard to enjoy or a quieter unit complex lifestyle. Jane would make a wonderful companion for someone looking for a gentle, low-key grey to share life’s quieter moments with.

NAME: Duke
TEXT: Meet this gentle boy — a sweet and sensitive grey who is looking for a patient and caring adopter to help him feel safe and settled in his new home. While he may be shy at first, with a little time and understanding he begins to build trust and show his lovely personality. Once he gets to know someone, his confidence grows and he becomes a much more relaxed and engaging companion. As he settles in, his playful side starts to shine through, and he enjoys having fun and interacting with those he feels comfortable around. Watching him come out of his shell and gain confidence is incredibly rewarding, and he forms strong bonds with the people who give him the time and reassurance he needs. He has also handled stairs well, showing he can adapt confidently to different home environments. This lovely boy would thrive in a calm, supportive home where he can continue building his confidence at his own pace and enjoy the companionship and security of a loving family.

NAME: Adrian
TEXT: Meet Adrian — a very social and engaging grey with a confident, easygoing nature that makes him a pleasure to be around. Adrian enjoys interacting with people and naturally draws others in with his friendly personality and calm confidence. He’s the kind of companion who settles in quickly and enjoys being included in everyday life. Adrian has shown himself to be very confident in different situations, including being comfortable and capable with stairs, which makes him adaptable to a wide range of living environments. Whether in a busy family home, a quieter household, or a unit setting, Adrian’s relaxed and adaptable temperament means he is likely to thrive wherever he goes. He has also been exposed to younger children and has shown himself to be comfortable around them, making him a lovely option for families looking for a gentle and social companion. With his affectionate nature, confidence, and ability to fit easily into different lifestyles, Adrian is ready to bring companionship, warmth, and plenty of happy moments to his future home.

NAME: Blaze
TEXT: Meet Blaze — a confident, outgoing boy with a fun-loving spirit and a heart full of adventure. Blaze loves exploring the world around him and is always eager to see what’s happening, whether it’s heading out for a walk, discovering new places, or joining in on family activities. He’s a social and engaging companion who enjoys being around people and quickly wins everyone over with his friendly nature and charming personality. One of Blaze’s favorite things is playing fetch, and he’ll happily spend time chasing after toys and bringing them back with enthusiasm. He’s playful without being over the top and knows how to enjoy both active moments and relaxed downtime. Blaze also gets along beautifully with other greys, making him a wonderful addition to a home with canine companions or regular doggy playdates. With his confident nature, affectionate personality, and easygoing social skills, Blaze is the kind of dog who brings warmth, fun, and companionship wherever he goes.

NAME: Angel
TEXT: Angel is a lovely and beautiful blue fawn girl. She is confident and social, she relaxes well around other dogs regardless of size or breed. Great with kids and is good on the lead.

NAME: Rich
TEXT: The handsome laid back gentleman lives on the south coast and has had a wealth of exposure to a range of different animals, mixed breeds of dogs and cats to name a few. He is great with all sized and aged people and is a happy confident boy.

NAME: Macaroni
TEXT: Macaroni is in a foster care home in an apartment - Foster Update: "Everything has been going so well with sweet Macaroni, she’s truly been such an angel. As first-time fosters for a senior greyhound, we were a little nervous at first, but she has been nothing but gentle, loving, and easy to care for. She is also incredibly well toilet-trained, in the week we’ve had her, she has only toileted outside and hasn’t had a single accident indoors. Each day she’s been growing more comfortable and showing more of her sweet personality. She now gets excited for her morning and afternoon toilet walks, and around lunch and dinner time she’ll happily wag her tail and do little jumps of excitement. For an older girl, it’s so lovely to see those playful moments still shine through. As she settles in, Macaroni has also become more affectionate and enjoys being closer to her people throughout the day. We think once fully comfortable, she’ll become a true little love bug. I think Macaroni would thrive in a calm and loving home with someone who enjoys a quieter lifestyle and would love a gentle companion to relax alongside. She’s very brave and easygoing, sounds, music, cars, and general day-to-day activity don’t seem to bother her at all. She loves having cozy spots around the house to nap and sleeps peacefully through the night." ----------------------------------- Macaroni is a gentle, quiet and independent little old lady who is happy to do her own thing. She is ultra calm, loves treats, is well mannered and oh so sweet and laid back. Once she knows you she will put her head on you for a pat. She would be best suited to an only-pet home as she prefers down time and chilled out vibes. She is apartment suitable, showing lovely toileting manners when indoors in our office all day, happy to snooze the day away then wake up to tell us it's toilet time. At 11 years young, it goes without saying that a quiet lifestyle and less brisk activity is best suited, as well as a home without stairs. Older/quiet kids are best suited as she loves to relax. She is very laid back and has been left alone for long stints in the office and done well so full time workers are suitable. She loves to sunbake so she can't wait to find the sunny patch at your place! Meet Macaroni by appointment with her foster family at Western Sydney.

NAME: Hilda
TEXT: Meet Hilda – Beauty, Charm, and a Whole Lot of Heart 🐾 Hilda is a stunning 3 ½-year-old female greyhound who truly has it all — the looks, the personality, and the sweetest nature you could hope for. With her graceful elegance and gentle soul, she turns heads wherever she goes, but it’s her loving heart that will truly win you over. Hilda is a friendly, affectionate girl who adores being around people. She thrives on companionship and loves nothing more than spending quality time with her humans, whether that’s a relaxed afternoon by your side or a playful moment in the yard. Her happy, playful nature makes her a joy to have around, and she brings a lovely energy into every home she visits. Social and well-mannered, Hilda gets along beautifully with other dogs, making her a wonderful addition to a home with an existing canine companion or one where she can enjoy regular doggy friendships. Hilda is looking for a loving family who will welcome her as a treasured member of the household. She would flourish in a home where she can be included in daily life, given plenty of affection, and, of course, a little bit of spoiling (which she absolutely deserves!). If you’re searching for a loyal companion with a gentle spirit and a playful heart, Hilda might just be the perfect match. 💕

NAME: Mary
TEXT: *Hi, I'm in a foster care home looking for my forever home!* Mary is a sweet, shy greyhound who is still building her confidence and would suit a calm home. She has been around children aged 6, 8, and 11 years old so she may suit a home with respectful, dog-savvy kids. Mary walks well on lead and after she settles in we think she'd love to get out and about on walks. She enjoys exploring and engaging with her environment so a house with a yard/townhouse size yard is best suited. Shorter hours alone is best suited. Socially, she is polite with other dogs and could live with a medium to large breed dog. Overall, Mary is a gentle greyhound who will thrive in a quiet, understanding home where she can build confidence at her own pace and gradually grow into a relaxed, affectionate companion. Mary is available at Western Sydney!

NAME: Ernie
TEXT: *Ernie is in a foster care home with a small dog - check in soon for updates!* Ernie is a small and shy boy who has made a lot of progress at the adoption centre. He is looking for a special home who will nurture him and continue his confidence building. He requires a family willing to take things slow with him as we have here. He would thrive as a solo dog with a 1-2 adults at home, or a calm dog to keep him company. He could spend a few hours alone or longer, with a secure yard or courtyard. He is very sweet, cuddle and adorable once he trusts you (see photos of all his cuddly moments!). It will be a highly rewarding journey for whoever adopts our special boy Ernie. He loves lying on blankets in the garden, sitting in his shell pool and cuddling you once he knows you. Meet Ernie by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Tilly
TEXT: Tilly is a sweet and affectionate greyhound with a calm nature and a love for family life. A true water baby, she absolutely loves swimming in the dam and would thrive in a home where she can enjoy outdoor adventures and plenty of companionship. Tilly is polite and relaxed around other dogs, both big and small, and has experience living around farm animals, puppies, and children. Her gentle temperament and adaptable personality make her a wonderful candidate for a variety of homes. She loves affection, enjoys being close to her people, and responds well to her name when called. Tilly’s loving and easy-going nature shines through in everything she does, making her a beautiful companion both at home and out exploring. Tilly is now searching for a caring forever family who will cherish her kind heart, playful spirit, and love of life.

NAME: Spud
TEXT: Spud is a fun-loving boy with a big personality and an even bigger heart. Gregarious and excited when he first meets people, he settles quickly and shows just how affectionate and easy-going he really is. One of Spud’s favorite things in the world is toys — he absolutely loves them and proudly shows them off to everyone he meets. His playful nature and happy enthusiasm make him a joy to be around. He is a water baby who loves swimming with his friends! Spud has been raised around farm animals and is good with small dogs, showing polite manners around both food and toys. He is comfortable with being patted all over, travels well, and settle's nicely crate, demonstrating a calm and adaptable side once he relaxes. Full of character, Spud is looking for a home that will enjoy his playful spirit, loving personality, and entertaining charm. He is ready to become a loyal and much-loved companion.

NAME: Star
TEXT: Meet handsome ✨ Star ✨ Star is a stunning male greyhound who is ready to find a loving forever home after deciding racing life just wasn’t for him — he was simply far too slow, but what he lacks in speed he more than makes up for in personality. Star has shown lovely manners around other dogs, including great interactions with Noodle the whippet. He is very easy-going, gentle boy to have around. Unlike some greyhounds, Star isn’t overly food motivated, but he absolutely loves toys and enjoys watching his canine friends zoom around and play. He is calm, observant, and happy to engage at his own pace. Star would suit a home looking for a relaxed, sweet-natured companion who enjoys company, enrichment, and a soft place to land. He’s ready to swap the racetrack for the couch and become someone’s best friend.

NAME: Fred
TEXT: Meet Fred ! A loyal, intelligent boy looking for a calm and confident home where he can truly thrive. ❤️ Fred is searching for an experienced and understanding owner who can provide clear boundaries, consistency, and the confidence he needs to feel secure. Once he builds trust, Fred forms strong bonds with his people and loves being included in daily life , especially if it involves attention, companionship, and a comfy place to relax nearby. While Fred can be social with medium to large dogs out and about, he would much prefer a home where he can soak up all the love and attention for himself as the only dog in the household. Fred has the ability to gradually work up to being left alone for full-time hours with the right routine and settling period, making him a great companion for someone willing to give him time to adjust and feel comfortable in his new environment. Due to his needs, Fred would be best suited to an adult-only home or one with older, dog-savvy children who understand how to respectfully interact with dogs and can help maintain a calm household environment. For the right person, Fred will be an incredibly rewarding companion — loyal, affectionate, and ready to find a home where he can finally relax and belong. 🐾 Meet Fred at Western Sydney Adoption Centre

NAME: Nugget
TEXT: Nugget is an absolute goofball who is guaranteed to keep you smiling every single day! This fun-loving greyhound has a big personality and an even bigger love for life, he’s always ready to be right in the middle of whatever’s going on. Full of playful energy, Nugget thrives on interaction and loves being part of the action. Whether it’s a game, a walk, or just hanging out with his people, he’s happiest when he’s included. His silly antics and cheeky charm make him endlessly entertaining, and he’s always finding new ways to make you laugh. Despite his playful nature, Nugget also has a sweet side and enjoys spending time with his humans, soaking up attention and companionship. He’s the kind of dog who brings joy, laughter, and a whole lot of personality into the home. If you’re looking for a fun, lively companion who will keep life exciting and full of love, Nugget is your guy

NAME: Tiger
TEXT: Tiger is a handsome boy with a calm, confident presence that makes him stand out from the crowd. True to his name, he carries himself with quiet strength, but underneath it all is a cruisey, easygoing companion who takes life in stride. Nothing much fazes Tiger. He approaches new situations with confidence and settles in quickly, making him a wonderful choice for someone looking for a relaxed, low-fuss dog. Whether he’s out enjoying a leisurely stroll or simply watching the world go by, Tiger is happiest when he can just cruise along at his own comfortable pace. He has a gentle, laid-back personality and enjoys the simple things, good company, a soft place to rest, and a bit of affection from his humans. Tiger isn’t demanding; he’s content to be by your side, offering quietly loyal companionship. If you’re looking for a steady, confident greyhound with a chilled-out vibe and a heart of gold, Tiger could be your perfect match

NAME: Felix
TEXT: Felix is a beautiful greyhound girl with a playful spirit and a heart full of love. She brings the perfect balance of fun and affection, making her an absolute joy to have around. Felix is a big fan of toys and loves nothing more than a good play session. Whether she’s happily carrying her favourite toy around or inviting you to join in the fun, her cheerful energy is sure to brighten your day. When playtime is over, Felix is all about the cuddles. She’s a total snuggle bug who adores being close to her people, soaking up pats and enjoying those quiet, cozy moments together. Her gentle, affectionate nature means she forms strong bonds and truly thrives as part of a loving home. Felix really is the best of both worlds—playful, loving, and endlessly sweet. If you’re looking for a wonderful companion who will keep you smiling and shower you with affection, Felix could be the perfect addition to your family.

NAME: Jane
TEXT: Jane is a truly special greyhound with a gentle nature. Affectionate, playful, and incredibly sweet, she’s the kind of dog who effortlessly wins over everyone she meets. She adores being close to her people, happily leaning in for cuddles and soaking up every bit of attention she can get. Her loving personality makes her a wonderful companion, always ready to offer quiet comfort or a warm presence by your side. But Jane also has a playful spark! She enjoys her moments of fun, whether it’s a light game, a little burst of energy, or simply exploring her surroundings with curiosity and joy. Her balance of playful spirit and calm affection makes her easy to love and even easier to live with.

NAME: Betty
TEXT: True to her name, Beautiful Betty is an absolute delight, inside and out. This gorgeous greyhound is bursting with love, joy, and a personality that lights up every room she enters. Betty has a zest for life that’s simply infectious. Whether she’s doing happy zoomies, exploring her surroundings, or soaking up attention from her favorite humans, she approaches each day with enthusiasm and charm. Her affectionate nature means she’s always ready for cuddles, leaning gently in for pats and sharing her sweet, loving presence. She thrives on connection and will quickly become the heart of any home. Betty’s warmth, playful spirit, and gentle soul make her the perfect companion for someone looking for a dog who brings both fun and comfort in equal measure.

NAME: Sue
TEXT: Meet Sue, a gorgeous 6-year-old black greyhound with a gentle soul and the sweetest little tail wag. This lovely middle-aged lady enjoys quiet exploring, friendly sniffs with other greyhounds, and slowly warming up to her people once she feels comfortable. Sue walks beautifully on lead and has a calm, easy-going nature, though loud environments can make her a little unsure. She’s friendly with other greyhounds and has shown manageable behaviour around small dogs, but she is not suitable for a home with cats. Sue is currently uncomfortable with crates and may need patience and reassurance with transport and confinement. With her soft nature and adorable personality, she’ll make a lovely companion for someone looking for a sweet and gentle best friend. Meet Sue at Western Sydney.

NAME: Fin
TEXT: Fin is a gorgeous girl looking for a calm, secure home to call her own. She can be quite shy when she first meets you but she responds beautifully to gentle encouragement, comes when called, and gradually relaxes over time. Fin is friendly with big and small dogs, walks lightly on lead, enjoying a sniff around gently and quietly. Once she warms up she likes to do zoomies and likes toys and treats. She is affectionate with other dogs big and small, greeting them softly and politely. Her best suited doggie pal is a medium to large breed. Due to her sensitive nature, she would be best suited to a quieter home without young children. With patience and reassurance, this lovely girl has all the makings of a gentle, perfect greyhound to be your new best friend. Meet Fin at Western Sydney.

NAME: Wanda
TEXT: Wanda is a gorgeous girl full of plenty of excitement.
