One thing to note: Tilly does not like sharing her food, so mealtimes are best managed separately from other dogs. Overall, Tilly is a swee, and well‑mannered girl who would make a wonderful companion for someone seeking a friendly, relaxed Greyhound who blends easily into day‑to‑day life.

NAME: Turbo
TEXT: Turbo is an active, outgoing Greyhound with a friendly and confident personality. He enjoys playtime and getting involved in what’s happening around him, but once he’s had his fun, he settles well and is quiet and easy to have around. He’s very people‑oriented and would suit a home with children aged 10 and over who can enjoy his playful side while giving him space when he’s resting. Turbo’s mix of energy, friendliness, and calm downtime makes him a great fit for families or individuals looking for a sociable but well‑mannered companion.

NAME: Gemma
TEXT: Meet Gemma Gemma is a sweet little girl with a beautiful nature and a cheeky personality to match. This lovely lady has a gentle heart but also a playful, fun side that will keep you smiling. Gemma loves being around people, though is also fine being on own. With her gorgeous looks and lovable personality, Gemma is sure to steal hearts wherever she goes. She would make a wonderful companion for someone looking for a beautiful girl with a mix of sweetness and cheeky charm. 🐾

NAME: Chester
TEXT: Meet Chester a sweet and gentle boy who is looking for a loving home where he can truly shine. Chester has a calm and affectionate nature and enjoys being close to his people. He’s the kind of companion who will happily sit by your side, enjoying quiet moments and soaking up all the attention you can give. With his kind personality and loving heart, Chester would make a wonderful companion for someone looking for a loyal friend to share their days with. All he needs is a caring home where he can feel safe, loved, and part of the family.

NAME: Jax
TEXT: Meet Jax, a calm and sweet-natured boy who will quickly win you over with his gentle personality. Jax is a friendly companion who enjoys being around people and thrives on affection and attention. He loves the company of other dogs and would happily share his home with a canine friend. With the right, slow introduction, Jax could also potentially be cat workable, making him a great option for a variety of homes. With his easygoing temperament and loving nature, Jax is the kind of loyal companion who will happily be by your side for walks, relaxing days, and plenty of pats. Anyone looking for a friendly and affectionate greyhound will find a wonderful mate in Jax.

NAME: Jay
TEXT: Meet Jay, a fun-loving boy with a beautiful nature. This happy boy has a bright bubbly personality and a friendly spirit that makes him a joy to be around. Despite his playful side, he also has a gentle temperament and loves attention and affection from his people, just look at that cheeky smile! With his sweet personality and charm, Jay will make a wonderful companion for someone looking for a loyal, fun, and loving greyhound to share their days with.

NAME: Jess
TEXT: Jess is a lively and affectionate dog who loves getting out and about. She’s great on the lead and enjoys exploring with her people. Jess has a playful personality and absolutely loves to run around and have her zoomies when the mood strikes. She can be a little skittish around new or loud noises, so she would do best with a patient and experienced owner who can help her build confidence and feel secure. Jess has had good socialisation with a cattle dog and enjoys canine company when introductions are done properly. With the right home, guidance, and plenty of love, Jess will make a loyal and entertaining companion.

NAME: Ken
TEXT: Ken is a lovely boy who is very friendly, plays well with toys, good with kids and great on the lead, he also lives around native and domestic animals.

NAME: Muza
TEXT: Maza is a sweet and gentle girl . She can be a little shy at first and prefers to stick close to her favourite humans, but once she feels comfortable, her affectionate and playful side shines through. She gets along well with other dogs, both small and large, and enjoys joining in on gentle play. Maza travels well in the car and is very food-motivated, which makes training and bonding with her easy. Once she opens up, she’s full of fun and love, making her a loyal and delightful companion.

NAME: Dolly
TEXT: Meet Dolly! Dolly is a calm, confident, and happy greyhound who loves exploring and spending time with people. She is gentle, friendly, and extremely affectionate, enjoying pats and attention from anyone she meets. Dolly loves to travel in the car, settles easily in new places, and is clean in her kennel. She is great with children, polite around small dogs, and super excited to meet other greyhounds. If they are playing then she wants to join in too! Dolly enjoys a sunny snooze spot, adventure walks and most of all time with her humans.

NAME: Timmy
TEXT: Timmy is a handsome, charismatic blue brindle guy! Timmy has spent a short amout of time in a home and his carers have said he is a big cuddly teddy bear of a dog with a goofy side! He is a dream to walk on the lead, loves to collect his toys on his bed, is a quick learner and is hilarious when he plays with his squeaky toys. They found he loves to nap and relax and didn't mind being left alone up to 3 hours if he gets a nice sniffy walk beforehand, but would propably prefer a home where someone is around fairly often to keep him company. Timmy would be suitable to live with older/experienced kids, as Timmy can get excited and forget his size in the heat of the moment. He can live with another dog his size however he doesn't need the companionship. We have also noticed Timmy is a smart boy here at GAP HQ and loves his food. He can even do stairs! So come and meet Timmy at the Western Sydney adoption centre. He can't wait to meet you!

NAME: Ace (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Hi, I'm Ace! I walk nicely on the lead and warm up after I get to know you. I like toys, and am described as friendly and calm. I would be happy to live with another dog after a meet and greet with them. As I can be shy, a dog who can help me come out of my shell could be a good match for me! As I have not experienced much of pet life yet, a home willing to take it nice and slow with me is best suited. A home with older/respectful kids would suit me best, as well as a house with a backyard for me to spend time in. Meet me at Western Sydney.

NAME: Thunder
TEXT: Thunder is a playful, funny, confident and friendly boy. He has an upbeat personality, and would love a home with toys, fun, and adventures! In his preperation to become a pet, he has learnt crate training, swimming in pools and dams, seen things like mowers, vehicles, and has been around kids 2-6 years old. He can be eager to get going on walks so a family who can walk a stronger dog is best suited. He could live with another doggie his size, however not a requirement. He is bouncy, friendly, and fun loving. A home with a backyard and shorter hours alone when he first settles in would be a great fit for Thunder. Meet Thunder at Western Sydney!

NAME: Patchy
TEXT: Hi, I’m Patchy — a young, gentle boy looking for a calm, nurturing home. I’d love a backyard where I can relax and have some quiet time, in a peaceful neighbourhood with a family who understands that I may take a little time to settle in. I’m naturally quiet and curious, and once I feel safe my sweet personality begins to shine. Because I’m a sensitive soul, a home without children or lots of hustle and bustle would suit me best. Meet me by appointment in Western Sydney. 🐾

NAME: Georgia
TEXT: Georgia is a timid girl who will need a patient and understanding home to help her feel safe and settled. She can be quite reserved at first, so she will benefit from adopters who have experience and are willing to give her the time and gentle guidance she needs to build confidence at her own pace. Georgia is happy to quietly observe the world around her and tends to be quite independent, preferring to take things in from a comfortable distance while she learns to trust her surroundings. She has shown that she can do well with medium sized dogs and may appreciate a calm canine companion. With plenty of patience, consistency, and a supportive environment, Georgia has the potential to slowly come out of her shell and feel secure in her new home. 🐾

NAME: Danny
TEXT: Danny is a lovely, placid boy who enjoys spending time with his people and soaking up plenty of pats. With his gentle nature, he truly values human companionship and is happiest when he’s close by, happily engaging with those around him. He also has a soft spot for children, showing a calm and patient demeanor that makes him a wonderful family companion. One of Danny’s favourite things is water, whether it’s splashing around, wading in, or simply being near it. This love of water adds a fun and playful side to his otherwise relaxed personality, making outings to the river or a safe swimming spot especially rewarding for him. Danny is great with all dogs, he walks well on the lead even with children. Overall, Danny is a sweet, affectionate companion who will thrive in a home that can provide him with plenty of love. In return, he’ll offer loyalty, warmth, and a calm, loving presence plus a little splash of fun wherever there’s water involved.

NAME: Ruthie
TEXT: Meet Sweet Ruthie 🐾 Ruthie is a beautiful 3-year-old greyhound who is gentle and has a petite little frame. She has a calm, sweet nature and carries herself with quiet grace. Ruthie has been wonderful around small dogs, showing respectful and polite manners, and she takes everything in her stride with her soft, easygoing temperament. She would make a truly lovely addition to a family looking for a gentle, affectionate companion. With her sweet personality and kind heart, Ruthie is ready to settle into home life and share all the love she has to give. If you're searching for a calm, cuddly best friend with the sweetest soul, Ruthie might just be your girl!

NAME: Obi Wan Kenobi
TEXT: This is Obi-Wan Kenobi — a brave Jedi knight using the Force to steal hearts across the adoption centre. Obi-Wan Kenobi loves his walkies and might even do a little happy dance when he sees his lead! Loves an adventure, making him a great fit for an active family who enjoy long walks through the galaxy. He is perfectly behaved indoors at the adoption centre. Gentle, affectionate, and loves chilling out, Obi has the quintessential greyhound personality — laid back with moments of playfulness. Obi-Wan Kenobi seeks a family who will respect his Jedi calmness but also embrace his playful side. He’s suited for homes with a peaceful vibe and a little space to run around. Apply for our special boy Obi — and may the peace, paws, and happiness be with you! 🌟🐾

NAME: Ferrari
TEXT: Don’t let her name fool you - Ferrari is a gentle, quiet girl with a soft and reserved nature. She may take a little time to come out of her shell, but with patience and love, her sweet personality truly begins to shine. Ferrari has a stunning black and white coat that makes her just as beautiful on the outside as she is on the inside. She would suit a calm home where she can settle at her own pace and build confidence in a safe, loving environment. With the right home Ferrari will be a loyal and affectionate companion who will quietly steal your heart 🐾

NAME: Rocky
TEXT: Rocky is a gentle, affectionate greyhound with a heart as big as his soulful eyes. This lovely boy thrives on human company and is searching for a home where he can be the centre of someone’s world. Rocky is a naturally sweet, loving, and people focused dog. He adores cuddles, leans, and quiet moments with his favourite humans. He’s the kind of boy who bonds deeply and shows endless loyalty once he feels safe and loved. While Rocky is a total sweetheart with people, he’s at his happiest in a home where he can be the only pet. He loves having his own space and his own humans all to himself—he truly shines when he’s the solo star of the household.

NAME: Zues
TEXT: Meet Zeus A handsome boy with a charming short tail and a confident outlook on life, Zeus is a curious and capable greyhound who enjoys exploring his surroundings and taking in the world around him. Zeus is confident and inquisitive on walks. He travels well in the car and handles new environments with ease. While he enjoys a pat, food is definitely the way to his heart! He’s very food motivated, which will make ongoing training both rewarding and fun. Like many bright young hounds, he can become distracted by interesting sights and smells, so he’ll benefit from continued engagement and positive reinforcement to help him stay focused. Zeus has been well behaved around other greyhounds and has previously been kennelled with his sister. However, he can be selective with his canine company and would be best suited as the only dog in the home, where he can soak up all the attention. He would thrive with an owner who can provide structure, enrichment and regular adventures while continuing to build his skills. If you’re looking for a confident, clever and engaging companion to share your days with, Zeus could be the perfect fit.

NAME: Stewy
TEXT: Stewy is a happy, excited boy who brings fun and energy wherever he goes! He’s playful, full of personality, and absolutely loves a good round of zoomies to burn off his enthusiasm. This lively lad enjoys engaging with his people and will happily come over for pats, attention, and of course — cuddles. After a burst of play, he’s more than ready to snuggle up and soak in the affection. Stewy would suit a home that enjoys an interactive, playful companion and is ready to embrace his joyful spirit. If you’re looking for a dog who will make you smile every single day, Stewy might just be your perfect match. 💙

NAME: Hazel
TEXT: Meet Hazel 🌿 Hazel is a sweet girl with a placid, gentle nature that makes her a lovely companion. She has a quiet charm about her and thrives in a peaceful, steady environment. Hazel will need a little time to warm up to a new home, as new surroundings can feel overwhelming at first. With patience, reassurance, and a calm household, she will gradually come out of her shell and show her affectionate and loyal personality. She would do best in a calm home where she can settle at her own pace and build confidence. A slow and thoughtful introduction to a cat will be important, and she could be workable with a small dog companion with the right match and gentle introductions.

NAME: Aurora
TEXT: Aurora is a sweet, cuddly girl with a gentle heart and a loving nature. She adores affection and will happily soak up all the pats and snuggles once she feels safe and settled. She may be a little timid at first when meeting new people or adjusting to a new environment, but with patience and reassurance in a calm home, Aurora will soon blossom into a devoted and affectionate companion. Aurora would thrive in a semi-active household that enjoys a balance of relaxed downtime and daily walks or playtime. She is suitable for families with children of all ages, especially in a home that encourages kind and gentle interactions. With a slow and positive introduction, she could be workable with a small dog companion. If you’re looking for a soft, loving girl who will reward your patience with cuddles and loyalty, Aurora could be your perfect match. 🐾💕

NAME: Mavis
TEXT: Meet Mavis 🤍 Mavis is a gentle, sweet-natured girl looking for a calm and chilled home where she can truly relax and feel safe. She has a quiet presence and would thrive in a semi-active household that enjoys a balance of peaceful downtime and relaxed walks. She may be a little timid when first settling in, but with patience and reassurance, Mavis will gradually warm up and show her affectionate, loyal personality. Once she feels secure, she forms lovely bonds with her people and enjoys simply being nearby. Mavis would be best suited to a home with older children who can respect her space and understand her gentle nature. A slow and considered introduction to cats and small dogs will be important to help her adjust comfortably. She would particularly suit a part-time or work-from-home household, or an older couple looking for a devoted companion to share their days with.

NAME: Licorice
TEXT: Licorice is a big, sooky boy with an even bigger heart. He absolutely loves being around his people and thrives on companionship, affection, and attention. If you’re looking for a loyal shadow who wants to be part of everything you do, Licorice is your guy. He enjoys an active lifestyle and will happily join you for walks and playtime, but his new family will need to be mindful of his leg and ensure his exercise is appropriate and not overly strenuous. A balanced routine that keeps him engaged without overdoing it will suit him best. Licorice can be prone to separation anxiety, so he would do best in a home where someone works from home or is around for much of the day. Alternatively, a well-matched female dog friend could help keep him company and build his confidence when left alone. Due to his size and excitability, Licorice would be best suited to a home with older children who can handle his enthusiasm and help maintain calm, consistent boundaries.

NAME: Maple
TEXT: Meet Maple 🍁 Maple is a beautiful, placid girl with a gentle soul and a sweet nature. She has a calm presence that makes her a wonderful addition to a relaxed, loving home. Maple can be a little timid when first meeting new people or adjusting to new surroundings, but with a bit of patience and reassurance, she will slowly come out of her shell. Once she feels safe and comfortable, her affectionate and loyal personality truly shines. She would thrive in a calm household with a semi-active lifestyle — a home that enjoys a balance of quiet downtime and leisurely walks or play sessions. Maple is suitable for families with children of all ages, especially where kindness and gentle interactions are encouraged. With the right introduction, she would be workable with a small dog companion.

NAME: Tilly
TEXT: Meet Tilly Sweet 💕 Tilly Sweet is a placid, gentle girl with a heart as soft as her name. She has a calm and loving nature, making her a wonderful companion for a family looking for a sweet and steady presence in their home. While Tilly may be a little timid when first meeting new people or entering a new environment, she warms up beautifully when given a calm, reassuring space to settle in. Once she feels comfortable, her playful side shines through — she absolutely loves a good zoomie around the yard and enjoys spending time playing with her favourite toys. Tilly would suit a semi-active household where she can enjoy both relaxed downtime and some fun bursts of activity. She’s treat motivated, which makes training a rewarding experience and a great way to continue building her confidence. She could be workable with a small dog companion and would do best with a slow, gentle introduction to a cat. Tilly is suitable for a home with children of all ages, especially in an environment where interactions are calm and respectful as she continues to grow in confidence.

NAME: Addison
TEXT: Meet Addison 🐾 Addison is the sweetest 4-year-old girl who will completely steal your heart. With her adorable personality and affectionate nature, it’s impossible not to fall in love with her. To say Addison enjoys a cuddle and a pat is truly an understatement — she absolutely adores affection and will happily soak up all the love you’re willing to give. Her gentle, loving nature and beautiful soul melt the hearts of everyone she meets, she would fit well into a home with smaller dogs too. Addison is the kind of girl who will quickly become the centre of the family, bringing warmth, companionship and plenty of cuddles to her lucky forever home.

NAME: Ferb
TEXT: A word from his foster family: "Ferb has been going really well, we are really hopeful he will find a lovely family as he has such a gorgeous nature. He can be left alone for around 6 hours - ideally with a stimulation toy to play with or lick mat/similar or he does get a bit bored and lonely! He’s very well toilet trained. We think he would be a fantastic family dog as he is non-reactive and so good natured, he loves cuddles and being around people as much as possible. He is good on walks and will respond to commands (most) of the time, he has been very happy to meet lots of new friends." Ferb is a super loving and affectionate guy who will go up to anyone and everyone and snuggle right into them! He steals the heart of everyone he meets and we just adore him! Ferb also loves other medium-large size dogs and would gladly have a canine brother or sister for company while you are away at work. Ferb loves his food and is responding very well to training her at GAP HQ - he already walks perfectly on loose lead, recalls well, has been fantastic with toilet training, can lay down when asked and can walk up and down stairs. What a clever boy! Ferb would gladly share his home with older, respectful kids. A quieter home without too much hustle and bustle beyond the fence is best suited for Ferb. Apply to adopt Ferb today - available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Messi
TEXT: Messi is a confident, excitable and friendly young boy. He would love a home with a yard where he can explore and smell all the interesting things in his new world. He enjoys time with people and would love a home that is willing to share adventures with him and continue teaching him about the best things in life. Messi would be happy to live with another dog who is happy to play and explore but also relax together. He enjoys going out for walks and would love to get some nice treats from a family ready to share their life with him. Available by appointment at Western Sydney

NAME: Rocco
TEXT: Rocco is a sweet and affectionate gentleman who can be a little shy at first but quickly decides he wants to be your cuddle buddy. He is a gentle middle-aged boy who has spent time with children and other dogs who respectfully shared space with him. Rocco has been getting used to the daily grind, walking in busy park areas meeting people and seeing dogs but he would also love a quiet yard to laze around in the sun. Rocco would be best suited to a canine companion who is quiet and calm like he is and also would prefer to live with calm, older children. He would love someone home to settle him in and spend time with him getting him used to your world and helping him grow his confidence and show his sweet, affectionate nature. Available by appointment at Western Sydney

NAME: Gus
TEXT: Hey, It's me, Gus! I am confident and have been around lots of different things before...cars, dams, different surfaces, radios and TV's, all in preparation to meet my forever family! I have gone for walks to the local shops and seen lots of things that make me a confident well rounded dog. I am an excellent traveller and would be a great match for a family who are on the road a bit and want to take their dog with them. I have met people on street walks and enjoy the attention, I would also suit a home with a calm small or large dog. Small dogs seem to like my vibe! My overall energy is calm, friendly with bouts of playfulness guess I am your quintessential greyhound... I hope to meet you soon. Meet me by appointment at Western Sydney!

NAME: Barney
TEXT: If Barney's sweet and soulful eyes have caught your attention, keep reading to find out if you could be the perfect fit for our special guy, Barney. Barney is available to a home who can nurture a shy greyhound out of their shell. Barney requires a special home with a quiet lifestyle and a backyard with secure fencing where he can retreat to and enjoy the peace and quiet away from people when he needs it. A home without children is a must for our shy Barney, however a calm, wise and understanding dog of any size (small or large) would be a lovely companion to help him build his pet skills and help him adapt to his new life with his forever family. If you are someone who can provide a shy dog the structure, support, and ongoing confidence training that he needs to thrive as a pet, we'd love to hear from you. Barney is available for fostering or adoption by discussion with GAP team. We can't wait to hear from Barney's perfect family!

NAME: Leggy
TEXT: This handsome fellow is currently sharing a yard with another greyhound and spending time playing with a little Italian greyhound. He is very sweet and affectionate, loves to play and loves affection. Would be an excellent supervisor while your working in the yard.

NAME: Luna
TEXT: Luna is an energetic girl that enjoys a yard where she can cut loose in the morning and bust out some zoomies. Then like most greyhounds she's done, finished gone for the day and happy to cuddle up and relax. She shares a yard with Bubba and good left alone.

NAME: Malley
TEXT: Hi, I'm Malley! I've been learning lots of things about the world while I wait to be adopted. I am super friendly and will make a sensational first impression, if I do say so myself! I am very charming and think you will just love me! I know what a lounge is, how to navigate those weird things called "stairs", and have enjoyed spending time in an open crate, and spending time indoors, too. I'm a good traveller, I also love toys and treats and my handlers call me a big softie! I would prefer short hours alone as a solo pet and a slow intro to the big wide world as my horizons slowly expand as a pet with you. If you thought you might like a big affectionate softie like me simply reach out to the Western Sydney adoption centre :)

NAME: Bonnie
TEXT: Bonnie was breed to be on the couch, she likes to lounge around and keep it real. She is a pretty girl that looks like she would suit the apartment lifestyle.

NAME: Max
TEXT: Max is a beautiful active boy who loves to go on adventures max is suited to full time workers max loves older kids as he loves to play with toys and can sometimes forget his size with younger children. despite his energy max walks very well on lead max requires a larger fenced area to ensure he stays in the backyard all day as he can sometimes want to go and hang out around the neighbourhood. max is a clean and healthy boy and would suit your more active lifestyle

NAME: Lilo
TEXT: Lilo loves to feel the earth under her feet and be in the yard but she does also like affection and being close the ones she loves. She likes the water and cooling down on hot days. She will inspect new people she meets and will come around once she approves.

NAME: Stitch
TEXT: Stitch has lived around farm animals and native animals most of her life so she is unbothered by a lot of things. She may get excited but she calms down quite quickly. She is very confident and happy and would love a yard to look after.

NAME: Rapunzel
TEXT: Rapunzel loves any form of affection. She will come to you when called, she is confident and not bothered by much in life.

NAME: Geno
TEXT: Meet Geno, a sweet and happy boy who's sure to steal your heart with his wagging tail and bright eyes, as he loves nothing more than receiving pats from everyone he meets. Geno is a sociable pup who revels in the company of other dogs. His friendly demeanor means he'll quickly become a beloved member of any dog-friendly household. He's a fan of good meals and thoroughly enjoys his food. One of Geno's most endearing qualities is his love for the water. Geno loves to splash in his paddle pool and Geno is the perfect companion for those who appreciate a mix of play and relaxation. If you're looking for a sweet, happy dog who's as charming as he is friendly, Geno could be the perfect match for you. With Geno, every day is an opportunity for fun, affection, and shared experiences.

NAME: Dex
TEXT: Meet Dex, the strikingly handsome and robust canine companion who loves for water and has a zest for life, Dex is the ideal pet for those who appreciate an adventurous soul . Dex exudes strength and charm, preferring the company of larger dogs who match his playful energy and enthusiasm. Whether he's splashing around in a pool, pond, or simply enjoying a sunny day outdoors, Dex is happiest when he's with his big-sized friends. Toys are another passion of Dex's; he enjoys the simple pleasures of tug-of-war or a good game of fetch. His playful antics with his toys will surely keep you entertained. While he adores the companionship of big dogs, he prefers a home without small dogs to ensure everyone's comfort and harmony. Dex's energetic nature would thrive in a home with an active lifestyle, spacious yard, or access to dog-friendly outings. Embrace the adventure and heartwarming fun that Dex brings to every day. Are you ready to welcome a strong, water-loving, toy-enthusiast into your life.

NAME: Kota
TEXT: 🌸 Meet Kota - A Gentle Soul Looking for a Patient, Loving Home Kota is a very special girl with a soft heart and a sensitive spirit. She may take a little while to warm up, but once she trusts you, she forms deep, meaningful bonds that make every moment worth the wait. 💗 A Sensitive, Quiet Beauty Kota can feel a bit unsure in new environments, and she prefers to take things slowly. She’s not the kind of dog who rushes into new situations, she observes, thinks, and opens up at her own pace. But beneath that initial shyness is a truly affectionate, loyal companion. 🏡 Needs a Calm, Patient Home Kota will thrive in a warm, gentle, and patient household where she can feel safe and loved. She’ll do best with people who understand that trust takes time, and who are happy to give her the space and reassurance she needs to blossom.

NAME: Ray
TEXT: Hey, I'm Ray! You could say I am a ray of sunshine, I'm so friendly and vibrant and ready to light up your life! 🔆 I will give you cuddles, licks and give you an amazing first impression with my confident personality. My best suited home is a home who loves all things greyhounds - from my zoomies to my naps. I love zoomies and play, and I will be your sweet and joyful companion who will always be wiggly and cute when you get home from work. I will run around and keep you active, so a home with a yard is going to be great for me and my sunshine personality! I can be excited to get going on the lead but I will be eager to learn and walk nicely once we get into routine. My best suited home is one with shorter hours alone while I settle in, I can also go home with a medium to large canine companion. If you need some more rays of sunshine in your life, come and meet me at Western Sydney!

NAME: Shelby
TEXT: Shelby is a very energetic greyhound who’s always ready to go. She’s best suited to an active lifestyle with plenty of opportunities to burn off her energy and enjoy structured play. If Shelby is rehomed with another dog, she’ll need an experienced owner and a canine companion who can truly match her energetic play style. She plays hard and would do best with a confident, compatible dog who enjoys the same level of activity. A secure backyard is a must for Shelby, giving her the space she needs to run, play, and unwind. In the right home, Shelby will thrive as a fun, lively companion for someone who loves an active dog.

NAME: Lenny
TEXT: Lenny is a beautiful male greyhound who knows exactly what he likes—and he likes his own space. He’d be happiest as a solo dog, where he can fully relax and enjoy being the center of attention. Out and about, Lenny is perfectly fine around other dogs and handles public settings well, but he’s not a fan of other dogs getting too close in his personal bubble. Because of this, he’s best suited to a home where he can have his space respected. Lenny would thrive in a semi-active household and is accustomed to being handled by kids, making him a great option for a family that understands dog boundaries. He’s a lovely boy with lots to offer the right home.

NAME: Roger
TEXT: Roger is a handsome black greyhound with a calm, easygoing vibe. He’s a pretty chill dude who enjoys a relaxed lifestyle and doesn’t ask for much beyond comfort, kindness, and a good routine. Roger would do best as a solo dog or with a female canine companion. He can be workable with small dogs and even cats, given the right introductions and management. His laid-back nature makes him a great match for full-time workers or a family looking for a low-key, affectionate dog. If you’re after a gentle, uncomplicated companion who’s happy to go with the flow, Roger might just be your guy.

NAME: Mickey
TEXT: Mickey is a gorgeous white and blue male greyhound with a truly lovely personality — and he’s a smaller boy too, which just adds to his charm. He’s sweet, gentle, and a pleasure to have around. Mickey has spent time in a house and is comfortable being indoors, though he hasn’t lived full-time inside yet. He can manage stairs going up, but will need some support and patience with coming back down as he continues learning. He is workable with small dogs and, with the right slow and careful introductions, may also be cat workable. His future family will need to be prepared to put in the time and consistency to help him succeed, but Mickey’s kind nature makes him well worth the effort.

NAME: Fang
TEXT: Fang is a striking white and red brindle male greyhound with a gentle, sensitive nature. He walks nicely on lead and enjoys getting out for calm, relaxed strolls. When first meeting new people, Fang can be a little nervous and appreciates a slow, patient approach. He will come over for pats, but prefers things to be taken at his pace — once he feels safe, he settles beautifully and shows his sweet, trusting side. Fang had a calm interaction with a small dog, enjoying a polite sniff before disengaging, and he showed lovely manners around other greyhounds during his assessment. He would do best in a home that understands shy dogs and is happy to let him build confidence in his own time.

NAME: Romeo
TEXT: *Romeo is in a foster care home in the Inner West and he is available to adopt! Foster Update: Romeo is super happy, affectionate and playful pup (no resource guarding or sleep startle observed). He is quite confident and outgoing at home. When he’s asleep he is angelic and when he is awake, he is effervescent. He has settled in quickly, he knows where his beds are and has a sleep bed and a play bed, he figured out very quickly where his toys live and how to dig the goat horn his favourite toy out of the basket. Romeo is a quick learner and has now mastered indoor and outdoor steps. He is responding to his name most of the time. His playful antics make us laugh to no end. He is happy to pass dogs on a footpath without much notice. Favourite things about him: His beautiful soulful eyes, his stunning looks, his mischievous personality, his independence and his affectionate behaviour. *Romeo is available from the Western Sydney adoption centre via appointment with his foster carer*

NAME: Lou
TEXT: If you're looking for a friendly and outgoing companion, check out Lou! Lou has recently spent time in foster care where he mastered going to markets and meeting all the stall holders. Lou is a sweet, people-focused boy who enjoys routine, gentle companionship, and having his humans within eyesight. He walks beautifully on lead, took inner-city living in stride during foster care, and happily relaxed at cafés, pubs, and markets. He’s polite with other dogs on walks, enjoys calm play with other greyhounds, and absolutely adores squeaky toys and fetch. Lou is independent but affectionate, active in the mornings, and a cosy snoozer by evening when he has a comfortable spot to unwind. He will do best in a house with yard access, as smaller apartments made it difficult for him to fully settle and find his own space. When sharing a home with a medium–large dog, he benefits from structure around resting places and clear routines to keep everyone comfortable. Lou is a loving, joyful companion who thrives when given room to relax, predictable guidance, and a household that enjoys his mix of active playtime and peaceful downtime. Read below to see what Lou's foster carers had to say about him! "Lou is a beautiful boy with a lot of love to give. He walks very very well on the lead, ignores most birds and bush turkeys. He is not very interested in saying hi to other dogs and will respectfully walk straight past them. He loves squeaky toys with a passion and plays fetch with them with so much joy. He is a master of stairs. He would benefit from living in a house with a backyard, as our small apartment was a bit tight for him (he likes a safe space). In saying that he still wants to be within eyesight of you. He’s an independent but people loving doggie. He would benefit from an active owner - he is full of beans and loves longer walks and play time. He is most active in the mornings and is up for cuddles and play time, in the evening he likes to curl up and snooze independently." Apply now to meet Lou from our Western Sydney program.

NAME: Keith
TEXT: Keith is a handsome black greyhound with a touch of grey that only adds to his character — and don’t let it fool you, he’s still as active as ever. He’s social with smaller dogs and has a very easy-going, engaging nature that makes him a joy to be around. Keith loves company and would likely benefit from having a canine friend at home to share his days with. With his relaxed attitude and friendly personality, Keith would make a wonderful, loyal companion.

NAME: Lukey
TEXT: Lukey is a gorgeous brindle greyhound with a friendly, easygoing nature. He’s social with smaller dogs and enjoys getting out and about with nice walking manners. Lukey is very engaging with people and absolutely loves his cuddles, happily leaning in for affection. He also has a playful side that comes out once he’s comfortable, making him a lovely mix of fun and calm. Lukey would make a wonderful companion for someone looking for a sweet, affectionate greyhound with a bit of sparkle.

NAME: Arrow
TEXT: Arrow is a striking black male greyhound with loads of energy and a playful spirit. He’s still building his confidence and engagement with people, but once he feels comfortable, he really enjoys pats and quiet affection. Arrow is a very active boy who loves to play and would suit a home ready to match his enthusiasm. At this stage, he’s not suitable to live with small dogs. On lead, Arrow can become excited and will benefit from some initial training and guidance to help him settle into walks. With patience, structure, and a bit of fun, Arrow has all the potential to shine.

NAME: Streak
TEXT: Streak is a handsome black male greyhound with a gentle, charming nature. He offers a polite introduction to new situations and is very workable, including being comfortable around small dogs. Streak travels well and settles easily, making him a great companion for outings or adventures. He enjoys a good burst of zoomies when the mood strikes, but he’s just as happy to slow down for cuddles afterward. Very engaging with people, Streak loves human attention and forms sweet connections with those around him. He’s a wonderful mix of playful energy and affectionate calm.

NAME: Maestro
TEXT: Foster Update "He is so affectionate and loving and a bit goofy, all around a lovable boy!" and more below: - He loves to be near you or see where you are. I have left him at home for short stretches and a couple of times for longer stretches, but I haven't left him for a full workday. I think he could work up to this over time, but he would prefer to be in a home where people are around more frequently. He's not fussed about who is home, just likes any human being there. - He is friendly towards everyone and fine with meeting new people. - He doesn't really like walks right now. I have been working with him on this consistently. He will do okay in quiet areas and is good on the lead. - Huuuuuge couch potato. I usually can't get him out of bed until the afternoon, not even for breakfast! I think it's because he's a bit of a night owl; he has been more active late at night. - Super unphased by all animals. Not fussed about dogs coming up to him, barely flinches when he walks past houses with reactive dogs in them. ---------------- Maestro is a happy, big-hearted dog who knows how to enjoy the good things in life. His three greatest loves are food, affection, and toys, and he approaches all of them with pure enthusiasm. Treats are the fastest way to his heart, but cuddles and playtime come in a very close second. Maestro prefers shorter hours alone while he settles in and would prefer human companionship at the start of his adoption journey. He has shown within a fortnight in foster he can already settle for 6 hours on his own. Maestro is a friendly, social guy who does well with other dogs and enjoys their company. Whether it’s a shared walk, a play session, or just hanging out together, he’s comfortable having canine friends around. Come meet Maestro and see if he’s ready to make beautiful music with your family. 💛🐾

NAME: Miguel
TEXT: Say Hola to our beautiful boy Miguel! This adorable, bouncy little guy is going to make the best pet! Miguel is an outgoing boy who absolutely loves people, getting out for a stroll and about and playing with his humans. He's a clever cookie who loves food, making him very trainable and fun to teach new things. Miguel would love a chilled out home environment with a backyard or apartment to call his own to play and relax in. He loves to chill on a couch or in his crate. He would prefer to be the only pet in the household so he can take all the love and attention for himself. He has shown he has potential to work up to longer hours alone and has mastered crate training as well. So if you're looking for a fun-loving, adaptable, and trainable companion, Miguel is your guy! Apply to adopt this handsome boy online today.

NAME: Ellie
TEXT: Ellie is a beautiful 2-year-old female greyhound with a heart as big as her smile. Happy, playful, and affectionate, she is truly one of the loveliest dogs you will ever meet. 💕 Ellie adores people and has a gentle, friendly nature that makes her a joy to be around. She gets along wonderfully with dogs of all sizes and would happily share her home with a canine companion. Ellie also loves her toys and will entertain herself (and you!) with her playful antics. Great with kids and full of love to give, Ellie would make a fantastic family dog. She’s ready to settle into a home where she can be part of everyday life, enjoy playtime, and soak up plenty of affection.

NAME: Louie
TEXT: Louie is a happy boy who strikes the perfect balance between playful and laid-back. He loves zoomies and playing with toys, but he’s just as content relaxing and doing his own thing when it’s time to unwind. Louie is food motivated, which makes him a fun and rewarding boy to work with. He’s small-dog workable and enjoys human connection, while also being perfectly fine spending time independently. Due to his enthusiastic spirit, Louie would be best suited to a family with older children. A semi-active lifestyle will suit Louie well — one that includes playtime, daily outings, and plenty of chill time at home. If you’re looking for a greyhound with a great mix of fun and flexibility, Louie could be a wonderful addition to your family. 🐾

NAME: Ace
TEXT: Ace is a handsome black male greyhound who may be a little shy at first, but with a few gentle cuddles and some reassurance, he quickly comes out of his shell. Once settled, his sweet and affectionate nature really shines. Ace walks beautifully on lead, making daily outings calm and enjoyable. He also has a playful side and loves spending time with his toys, happily entertaining himself or joining in for a game. He’s a well-mannered boy around other dogs and is good with larger breed dogs. A big plus is Ace’s excellent disengagement skills, making him small-dog and cat workable with appropriate introductions and management. His thoughtful, responsive nature shows just how well he listens and adapts to his environment. Ace would thrive in a patient, loving home that understands he just needs a little time to feel safe—once he does, you’ll be rewarded with a loyal, cuddly companion. If you’re looking for a gentle greyhound who blossoms with kindness and affection, Ace could be your perfect match 🐾

NAME: Booboo
TEXT: Booboo is a handsome black male greyhound with a confident nature and a big love for comfort. One of his favourite pastimes is relaxing on a nice cozy bed, but don’t let that fool you—he’s also a very playful boy who enjoys having fun before happily settling back down. He’s best suited to a semi-active lifestyle and would fit in well with a family with older children who can respect his space. Booboo could also be workable with medium to large breed dogs with appropriate introductions. He’s comfortable with a full-time worker household, as he’s content chilling at home once his needs are met. Booboo is food motivated, which makes training and bonding an enjoyable experience. While confident in general, he can become frightened during thunder storms and would benefit from a calm home that can offer reassurance and a safe, cozy place to retreat during noisy weather. Due to his prey drive, Booboo is not suitable to live with small dogs or cats. If you’re looking for a playful yet relaxed companion who loves his comforts and enjoys being part of a calm, structured home, Booboo could be the perfect addition 🖤

NAME: Nosey
TEXT: Nosey is a gorgeous black greyhound with a big heart and a happy-go-lucky personality. He’s a confident, cheerful boy who brings a lovely balance of playful energy and laid-back chill to everyday life. Suited to a semi-active lifestyle, Nosey enjoys his walks and playtime but is just as content relaxing at home. He’s confident on lead, making outings easy and enjoyable, and he absolutely loves his toys. Add food into the mix and you’ve got his full attention—Nosey is very food motivated, which makes training a breeze. Nosey would do well with a full-time worker or as a solo dog, as he’s comfortable spending time on his own once settled. He’s adaptable and would suit a variety of adopters looking for a friendly, easygoing companion. Due to his prey drive, Nosey is not suited to living with smaller dogs or cats, but he more than makes up for it with his affectionate nature and joyful spirit. If you’re looking for a confident, fun-loving greyhound who knows how to switch between play mode and relaxation, Nosey might just be your perfect match 💛

NAME: Solly
TEXT: Solly is a striking young man with a personality that’s equal parts energetic and laid-back. He thrives on an active lifestyle—think brisk walks, playtime, and the occasional burst of zoomies to burn off his youthful energy. After he’s had his exercise, Solly transforms into a mellow cuddle enthusiast, always ready to relax with a wagging tail and plenty of affection. His gentle nature would likely fit well into a family environment, and he also might be suited for homes with full-time workers as long as he gets his daily dose of activity. If you’re looking for a loyal companion who can keep up on walks and then happily settle down for some quality downtime, Solly might be the perfect match for you!

NAME: Charlie
TEXT: Charlie is a friendly, playful, and affectionate male greyhound who enjoys being part of everyday life. He loves cooling off with a paddle in the pool on warm days and is always happy to jump in the car for an outing. Charlie thrives on spending time with his people and would suit a family who can include him in adventures, playtime, and fun activities. Charlie walks very well on a lead and is calm and reliable when out and about. He has confidently been walked by children aged nine years and older, making him a lovely option for a family with older kids. With his easy-going nature and love of companionship, Charlie would make a wonderful addition to the right home.

NAME: Sandy
TEXT: Meet Sandy 🐾 Sandy is a young female greyhound with a happy, active personality and a playful spirit. She is full of enthusiasm and would thrive in a home that enjoys spending time with her and helping her learn the basics of everyday life. Sandy would benefit from a family who are happy to put time into some gentle training and guidance. She is eager, playful, and would love a companion who will engage with her, play games, and help her build confidence as she learns life’s basics. With patience, consistency, and plenty of affection, Sandy will grow into a wonderful and rewarding companion for an active and caring home.

NAME: Girl
TEXT: Hi, I'm Girl! I'm young, cute, and looking for a new family. I can be shy in new places but I promise to be a big brave girl once I become a member of your family. Due to being a bit nervous, older children would be best suited for me. A home with a place to retreat would be the best, as I learn to thrive along side you, so a house with a yard or my own room would be really great! I am friendly with other dogs and show a cute little tail wag, showing off my brave side. I'm still young so a family who can train me and teach me all about the world would be amazing! Meet me by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Bandit
TEXT: Meet Bandit Bandit is a handsome male greyhound with a heart as big as his soulful eyes. He’s a quiet and easy-going boy who loves a calm environment. While he may be a little shy at first, Bandit quickly warms up and shows his sweet, affectionate nature. He’s great with small dogs and knows how to share his space politely. Bandit is also polite and well-mannered with children and has been around kids aged 7 and under, making him a wonderful family companion. A clean and tidy housemate, Bandit uses a doggie door like a pro, making him low-maintenance and independent. If you’re looking for a gentle soul who will bring peace and companionship to your home, Bandit is ready to steal your heart.

NAME: Dan
TEXT: Dan is a handsome 6-year-old male greyhound with a need for speed—he’s very fast and loves to run! When he’s not showing off his racing skills, Dan enjoys taking it easy and lazing around. He’s great with other dogs and relaxed around children, making him a wonderful companion for families. If you’re looking for a gentle, friendly boy who loves both adventure and chill time, Dan is your guy!

NAME: Dusty
TEXT: *I have just gone to foster care!* Hi, I'm Dusty, a distinguished, gentle boy looking for a couch to call my own. I am polite with other dogs and would suit a home with a calm medium-large companion - although not essential. A house with a backyard would be perfect, as I love to sniff around and enjoy the indoor outdoor lifestyle. A home who will continue training and enrichment games would be great as I am smart and have shown I'm eager to learn. A home without children is best as I can be shy around lots of stimulus. I need a home that is calm and consistent so I can build my confidence and settle in well. Meet me at Western Sydney!

NAME: Ollie
TEXT: Friendly, playful, and full of charm! Ollie is a sweet and sociable greyhound who loves making new friends—both human and canine! He’s playful without being over-the-top, and his gentle nature makes him a joy to be around. One of Ollie’s cutest quirks? When he gets excited, he likes to “nibble” your hands with his nose—a little affectionate nudge that will melt your heart. He’s looking for a loving home where he can enjoy cozy naps, fun play sessions, and plenty of attention. Ollie would thrive with someone who appreciates his affectionate personality and is ready to share lots of cuddles. Why you’ll love Ollie: Calm yet playful temperament Loves people and enjoys gentle interaction Unique and adorable habit of nudging hands when happy If you’re ready to welcome a loyal companion who will brighten your days, Ollie is waiting to meet you!

NAME: Stunner
TEXT: Stunner is stunning (hence the name), she lives in a rural environment around native and domestic animals and has always had young kids in her life. She is keen on playing with toys and walks well on the lead.

NAME: Bev
TEXT: Bev is a lovely girl who lives in a rural setting. She lives amongst domestic animals and has no shortage of roos, wombats, echidnas and birds coming past.

NAME: Fiama
TEXT: This special girl loves getting outside just so she can soak up the sun. She knows her name well and is good when left alone in the yard. She has grown up around kids and plays well with the other greyhounds.

NAME: Hamish
TEXT: Hi, I'm Hamish, a gorgeous blue fawn boy. I can walk up and down stairs, and loves a snuggle once I get to know you! I have been described as calm and well behaved, with a lovely nature. I'm a great traveller and would be happy to settle in the car for road trips. I'm calm and a bit playful around other dogs and would suit a home with another dog my size/medium to large size. Meet me at Western Sydney by appointment.

NAME: Bernie
TEXT: Bernie is a laid-back legend who loves car rides and walks! He’s great on the lead and enjoys taking life at a relaxed pace. While he might be a little shy at first, Bernie warms up quickly and will soon be your loyal mate. He’s easy-going, chilled, and gets along with all dogs—making him the perfect companion for a calm and happy home. “Bernie – Your easy-going adventure buddy!”

NAME: Flossy
TEXT: Flossy is a beautiful greyhound who’s nearly 9 years young and still full of grace. She’s the perfect mix of calm and affectionate, making her an ideal companion for someone looking for a loving, easygoing friend. Personality: Flossy is gentle, sweet-natured, and loves being part of a family. She enjoys quiet moments and will happily curl up beside you for a snooze. Compatibility: She gets along well with other dogs, so she’d fit perfectly into a multi-pet household. Lifestyle: Flossy is past her racing days and prefers a relaxed pace. A comfy bed, a few short walks, and plenty of cuddles are all she needs to thrive.

NAME: Astro
TEXT: Astro is a heart-melting, affectionate boy looking for a forever home full of love, snuggles, and good company. While he's great with dogs of all sizes, he requires a home without another dog in the home but would thrive with doggy play dates and group walkies. He settles well in a crate and has shown to know his name and learning recall. This sweet soul is very cuddly and affectionate – a true Velcro dog who wants to be near his people. Whether it's curling up on the couch, following you around the house, or gently resting his head on your lap, Astro’s love knows no bounds. He’s a great inside dog with lovely house manners, making him a perfect match for someone who is home more often than not. If you’re looking for a loyal best friend who gives as much love as he gets, Astro is your guy. Astro is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Panda
TEXT: Panda is a very tidy dog who is easy to train and fit in. He is confident and very affectionate. He loves to play and loves to wipe out and relax by your side. He is comfortable on his own which would make him suitable for fulltime workers or a busy family. Panda can do stairs and is very gentle and friendly boy.

NAME: Aussie
TEXT: Say hello to Aussie! 🐾 Aussie is a handsome 4-year-old black boy with a big heart and an even bigger love for people. If there’s a pat going, Aussie’s first in line — he never says no to some quality human affection! He’s a dream to have around: travels well, and has a calm, social nature that makes him great company wherever he goes. The handsome gentleman is more than happy to entertain himself in the backyard or curl up with you on the couch. He is great walking on the lead and has no issues exploring new places. Aussie gets along wonderfully with dogs of all shapes and sizes — small, medium, and large — and is always up for making new friends. With his gentle manners, easygoing vibe, and love for life, Aussie would make an amazing addition to almost any home. 💙

NAME: Benny
TEXT: Meet Benny🐾 Say hello to Benny, our big-hearted greyhound with an even bigger personality! This handsome lad is full of life, energy, and affection — the perfect mix of fun and love. Benny absolutely adores people and thrives on human company. Whether he’s greeting you with a wagging tail or leaning in for pats, he’s sure to win you over in seconds. Benny would love a family with a backyard where he can stretch his long legs, zoom around, and play to his heart’s content. After playtime, he’s more than happy to flop down and relax, enjoying some quiet time — he’s quite independent when he wants to be! When it comes to other dogs, Benny can be a bit selective with male dogs, so he’d likely be happiest as the only dog in his new home (as long as he has that backyard and plenty of human love, he’ll be in heaven!). If you’re looking for a big, goofy, affectionate companion who’ll make you smile every day, Benny is your boy. He’s ready to fill your home with love, laughter, and a few joyful zoomies!

NAME: Stella
TEXT: Meet Stella🌟 Say hello to Stella, a gorgeous greyhound with a heart as big as her smile! This social butterfly absolutely adores her canine friends and loves nothing more than a good play session with her doggy pals. Stella isn’t fazed by much — she takes everything in her stride with her calm, easy-going nature. Whether she’s out on an adventure or lounging at home, Stella is simply happy to be part of the fun. She’s a big fan of her humans too! Pats, ear rubs, and cuddles are always on her wish list, and she’ll happily follow you around or curl up at your feet once playtime is over. When she’s not making friends, Stella enjoys playing with her toys or just relaxing in a comfy spot nearby. With her affectionate personality and playful charm, she’s the perfect all-round companion. Stella’s dream home is one where she can share her days with loving humans (and maybe a furry friend or two) who will give her the love and attention she so happily returns.

NAME: Vern
TEXT: Vern is a gentleman who walks nicely on the lead, who is confident and happy around new people and happy to go gentle walks around the block everyday. A fenced backyard and a home who will include him in daily activities would be a great fit for him. Vern has a positive and welcoming nature which would see him suit a family with children. Meet Vern by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Billy
TEXT: Hi, I'm Billy! I'm a handsome fawn boy looking to find my perfect forever home. He is happy exploring new places and would enjoy a home with a fenced yard to call his own. He would love to be included in daily adventures like walks to and from the school pick up or spending time at the park! Billy is suitable to live with other dogs after a meet and greet. You can meet Billy at the Western Sydney adoption centre by appointment.

NAME: Teddy
TEXT: Affectionate boy Teddy is a sweet boy who walks gently on the lead and will greet you with a gentle tail wag. He is a calm, loving and sooky boy looking for someone to dote on him. He's easy to walk and has an easy going nature. He is friendly around other greyhounds and would suit a home with another dog. This cutie is available by appointment at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Jack
TEXT: Meet Jack🐾 Say hello to Jack, a cheerful and affectionate greyhound who’s ready to find his forever family! Jack has grown up around children and is wonderfully gentle and patient with them — he loves being part of family life and joins in with whatever’s going on, always making sure everyone is happy and safe. This lovely boy gets along brilliantly with other large dogs and enjoys having a playmate who can keep up with his energy. He can be a little unsure around smaller dogs at times, so he’d benefit from some calm, positive socialisation to help him feel more confident with them. Jack’s playful side really shines when he’s surrounded by his toys. He loves tossing them around, chasing after them, and showing off his collection to anyone who’ll watch! Between play sessions, Jack takes his role as “family supervisor” very seriously, checking in regularly with his people to make sure all is well before settling down again with a big grin and wagging tail. With his happy, affectionate nature and gentle heart, Jack would make a wonderful companion for a family looking for a fun, loving dog to share their days with. He’s full of character, always up for a bit of play, and even happier just to be near his humans. If you’re searching for a loyal, joyful friend who’ll bring laughter and love into your home, Jack is your guy. He’s ready to meet his forever family — and he can’t wait to check in with you! 💛🐶

NAME: Keith
TEXT: Meet Keith🐾 💛 Say hello to Keith, a stunning boy with a big personality and an even bigger heart. This charming boy has grown up surrounded by children, so he’s used to family life and all the noise, laughter, and cuddles that come with it. He’s gentle and patient with kids, always happy to join in on playtime or relax nearby while they do their thing. Keith is an excellent traveller, he hops into the car with ease and settles down quietly for the ride. Whether it’s a trip to the countryside or a quick run to the shops, he’s the perfect co-pilot who loves to be part of the action. When it comes to other dogs, Keith gets along beautifully with larger breeds and enjoys having a playmate of similar size and energy. He can be a little unsure around smaller dogs and would benefit from some gentle, supervised socialisation. True to his greyhound nature, Keith is a lovely mix of playful and laid-back. He adores his bursts of energy in the garden or at the park — chasing toys, stretching those long legs, and showing off his zoomies, but he’s just as happy curling up for a snooze on the sofa afterwards. He’s got the balance just right! Keith would suit most family environments, especially those looking for a single dog who can be the centre of attention. He thrives on affection and companionship and will reward his new family with endless loyalty, love, and plenty of cuddles.

NAME: Bj
TEXT: Meet BJ🐾 BJ is a wonderful male greyhound who’s great with all dogs and would fit perfectly into a home with children. He’s had positive experiences around kids before, making him a calm and gentle companion for family life. This affectionate boy absolutely loves pats and cuddles — he’s always ready to lean in for some extra love and attention. BJ also enjoys a splash in shallow water, happily cooling off and having fun when the chance arises. With his friendly nature, love for affection, and easy going temperament, BJ is a fantastic all-rounder who will bring warmth and happiness to any household. If you’re looking for a sweet, sociable greyhound who thrives in a family environment and gets along with everyone, BJ could be the perfect match for you.

NAME: Sully
TEXT: *I have been in a foster care home for 6 weeks - read the update below!* "Sully is going well and has settled in and shows signs of improvement almost everyday. He is very good with children and with all types of dogs. He loves a walk and is good on the lead. On the lead he is well behaved and does not respond when other dog are walking near him. If I stop and talk with another dog walker Sully is calm and relates appropriately with other dogs. Sully loves to drive in the car and enjoys the wind in his face as he keeps his head out of the window. He loves a cuddle and pat in the morning and anytime during the day if he is awake." ------------ Hi, I’m Sully — a gentle, quiet-natured blue boy looking for my new home. I love being around my people, get along well with other dogs, and I’m perfectly happy spending time in the yard while you’re out. I also love having the freedom to wander in and out as I please. I love the water – so much so that I even took a dip in the river (see photos)! I also travel great in the car and enjoy my walks, especially in quiet areas while I continue building my confidence. I like to take my time getting used to new environments, and once I do, I’m all in. I have even learnt to walk up and down stairs! I’m happiest in a home with a yard where I can stretch my legs and enjoy the fresh air throughout the day. I also like to sleep outside and would love a family who respects my boundaries when I’m resting or asleep. I also have experience in a pet home, so I already know the routine of a home life. I’m comfortable being left alone for a few hours, especially with a yard to explore and settle in. And when the day winds down, you’ll find me cozied up in my crate – it’s my little safe haven where I sleep soundly through the night. I'm available now at the Western Sydney adoption centre!

NAME: Jack
TEXT: Jack is a playful, sweet-natured boy with a cheeky streak and a big heart. He’s lived with a young cattle dog puppy and showed plenty of patience, and he currently shares his life with a couple of toddlers who climb all over him—he doesn’t mind a bit! Jack LOVES his toys (especially fetch!) and is super treat-motivated, which makes training and bonding a breeze. He’s all about having a good play, then flopping onto a comfy bed for a well-earned nap. Jack’s also been known to “reorganise” shoes around the house—just his way of helping with interior design! If you’re after a fun-loving, kid-friendly companion with a mischievous grin and a heart of gold, Jack’s your guy.

NAME: Burt
TEXT: Burt is a total character who thrives on human attention and isn’t shy about making sure you notice him! He can pull like a pro at first on walks, but give him a little time and he settles right down. Burt gets along with other greyhounds at home but prefers to be the king of his castle—he’s got a strong “mine” vibe when it comes to his food and toys. He’s great with kids of all ages and has plenty of experience being a patient, lovable buddy. Burt’s looking for someone who’s home most of the time to keep him company and soak up all his charm. Cats aren’t really his cup of tea, so a feline-free home would suit him best. Ready for a lively, loyal companion? Burt’s your guy!

NAME: Bertha
TEXT: Bertha is a calm and quiet lady who walks well on lead and prefers a relaxed lifestyle—perfect for someone looking for a low-key companion. She enjoys a little play with toys now and then, plus the occasional zoomie to remind you she’s still got some pep in her step. Bertha is best suited as a solo dog and would be a wonderful match for someone who wants a peaceful friend to share their days with—especially if you work from home and can keep her company. While she’s not a fan of cats, Bertha’s easy-going nature makes her a sweet and steady companion for the right home.

NAME: Jimmy
TEXT: Jimmy is a confident, energetic guy who walks beautifully on lead and loves to bound around with enthusiasm. He’s super engaging with people and thrives on treats—perfect for training and bonding! While Jimmy enjoys playing with other greyhounds during his outings, he prefers to be the only dog in the home to keep things calm and comfortable. Jimmy requires a cat-free home/small animal home. All-in-all Jimmy will require an experienced greyhound owner. Jimmy would shine in an active household where he can join in on plenty of adventures and daily fun. If you’re looking for a lively, loyal, Jimmy is your guy!

NAME: Hammer
TEXT: Ready to nail the perfect companion? Meet Hammer 🐾 Hammer is the ultimate all-rounder—a friendly, happy-go-lucky greyhound who gets along famously with other dogs of all shapes and sizes. Whether it’s a tiny terrier or a big labrador, Hammer’s easy going nature means he’s ready to make friends wherever he goes. This lively boy absolutely loves his zoomies and would thrive in a home with a backyard where he can race around and let loose to his heart’s content. When he’s not zooming, Hammer is a wonderful family dog—gentle, affectionate, and great with people of all ages. He’s equally happy as a solo dog or as the perfect companion for a young couple looking for a loving, energetic friend. Hammer is a cuddler at heart and enjoys spending quiet moments snuggled up with his humans after a day of fun and play. His engaging personality and happy disposition make him a joy to be around, always eager to say hello and share some love. If you’re searching for a playful, affectionate, and well-rounded greyhound who’s ready to bring energy and warmth into your home, Hammer might just be the perfect match!

NAME: Big Boy
TEXT: Say hello to Big Boy 🐾 Big Boy is a gentle giant with a heart as big as his name! This confident and max relaxer greyhound is a true people pleaser who adores everyone—from dogs and cats to children of all ages. He’s got a warm, friendly nature that makes him an instant hit wherever he goes. While Big Boy loves socializing, he prefers to be the king of his castle and would do best as a solo dog in his forever home. That said, he’s always up for a fun doggy playdate to stretch his legs and enjoy some furry friendship time. He knows how to keep things chill and relaxed, so his play dates tend to be happy and harmonious affairs. Big Boy would thrive in a home with a backyard where he can soak up the sunshine, lounge on the grass, or explore at his own leisurely pace. He’s happiest when a family member is working from home or part-time, as he enjoys company but is also perfectly content to kick back and chill solo when needed. Whether he’s snoozing quietly or spending quality time cuddling with his humans, Big Boy’s laid-back vibe brings calm and comfort to any household. On walks, Big Boy is a star walker, calm and confident on the lead, making every outing a peaceful pleasure for both dog and human. If you’re looking for a lovable, relaxed companion who’s a true social butterfly with a preference for solo living and fun play dates, Big Boy could be your perfect match. Ready to settle in and steal your heart, he’s waiting to become the gentle giant of your family!

NAME: Nitro
TEXT: Meet Nitro! ⚡️ Nitro is a fun-loving, affectionate greyhound with a playful spark and a big heart to match. At six years young, this handsome black boy brings a wonderful mix of lively energy and laid-back companionship. One moment he’s enjoying a happy burst of zoomies and exploration, and the next he’s soaking up pats and relaxing close to his people. Nitro is a confident little adventurer who loves getting out and about, taking in the world with curious sniffs and an enthusiastic stride. He enjoys being part of the action and has a bright, cheerful nature that makes him a delight to have around. He’s especially fond of affection and happily leans in for attention, enjoying every pat and cuddle on offer. Having spent time around children, Nitro is familiar with family life and enjoys being included in everyday activities. He’s social with other greyhounds too, enjoying playful interactions and friendly companionship with his fellow hounds. If he were to share his home with another dog, Nitro would likely be happiest with dog friends who enjoy a lively play style and can match his enthusiasm. Nitro travels beautifully, settles well during car rides, and is comfortable relaxing in his crate when it’s time to unwind after a day of adventures. He’s an eager walking buddy who enjoys being out in front, ready to lead the way with confidence and excitement. This charming boy would thrive in a home that can give him a balance of fun, companionship, and comfy downtime. Whether it’s an active household that enjoys daily walks and outings, or a family wanting an affectionate companion to share life with, Nitro is ready to bring plenty of love and personality into the home. If you’re looking for a sweet, spirited greyhound with a playful nature and a loving soul, Nitro could be the perfect addition to your family.

NAME: Matey
TEXT: *I have just aced my 8 weeks of foster care and I'm ready to go home with you!* Foster Update: "Matey is going great, enjoys his walks, enrichment toys and especially enjoys food! He now comes inside and runs straight to his bed and lies down, without me even needing to tell him, we are blown away with how well he is going!" Ahoy Matey! Matey is the finest gem of them all! With his pretty blue coat, floppy ears and gentle, curious and affectionate nature, this Matey is a bounty of charm waiting to be adopted! He is a super outgoing boy who just loves everyone he meets, especially if you have some yummy treats or play a game of fetch with him! Matey suits full time workers and loves spending his days outside with enrichment during the day - making him a great outdoor dog for a family looking for a pet who spends most of their time outside. Matey is an enthusiastic, gentle, smart and fun-loving boy making him suitable for those wanting a laid back yet playful friend. Matey suits full-time workers, and would enjoy a small yard to call his own. This handsome boy is available now from our Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Cindy
TEXT: Cindy is a sweet, quiet girl, who is lovely and soft with other dogs. She warms up well once you get to know her and becomes very sweet and affectionate. Cindy would suit a nurturing home where they can take things slow, but we're sure she will come out of her shell! A quiet home with a backyard to retreat to would be a perfect match for Cindy as she settles into pet life. A home without little kids is best suited as she is on the shy side. Available at Western Sydney!

NAME: Tails
TEXT: Meet Tails 🐕‍🦺 Tails has been in foster care with a wonderful family and their 2 greyhounds now for a few months. 💕 Tails has flourished in foster with Winnie and Potato teaching her the ropes. She loves going for walks and enjoys the beach. Tails is a collector of all things, she has learnt to clean up her toys and take them to her bed at night. She also collects many other things and looks after them. Tails would benefit from another confident playful greyhound friend like Potato to teach her the ropes and continue to bring out her confidence. Tails loves to play and run with her friend Potato in the yard while Winnie supervises watching fromt he sidelines ready to be the fun police if required.

NAME: Wooly
TEXT: Hey, I'm Wooly! I'm a quiet guy, looking for a quiet home. I warm up to new people but would prefer a nurturing chilled out place to call my own. I'd love my own backyard and don't mind mingling with other dogs big or small. I love food and will enjoy learning new tricks in my forever home. A home without children is best for me. I can't wait to meet you! Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Turtle
TEXT: Meet Turtle 🐢! A super social and playful boy. Turtle would prefer to live in a house where he has plenty of space to move around, explore, and feel comfortable. While he enjoys his energetic playtime, he also has a big heart and absolutely adores affection and attention from his humans. Whether it’s a good belly rub, a cozy cuddle, or just being near the people he loves, Turtle is happiest when showered with love. Another great thing about Turtle is that he’s crate trained, which means he’s not only fun and affectionate but also well-behaved and easy to manage in a family setting. He’s looking for a forever home where he can be part of an active family who understands his playful nature and can provide the exercise, companionship, and care he deserves. If you’re looking for a loyal, strong, and loving companion who will fill your home with joy and energy, Turtle is the perfect boy for you!

NAME: Jill
TEXT: Jill is a confident, friendly and affectionate girl described as 'wonderful' by her trainers here at the adoption centre. If you're looking for a super smart and focused girl, Jill's known cues are: name/recall, 'on your bed', off, down, touch, shake, chin rest, and drop (a toy). Jill loves toys & will play fetch with you. Her ideal home is a house with a backyard with colorbond fencing with shorter hours alone while she settles in. Jill requires a home without exposure to other dogs and requires an owner who lives in a low small dog populated area. She would thrive with an experienced greyhound owner who can continue her human engagement, training, focus training, and things like stationing on a bed, performing cues and recalling. She is happy to entertain herself in the yard during the day making her a good fit for those who work full-time and want a loving companion welcome them home everyday. Meet Jill at Western Sydney!

NAME: Spring
TEXT: Meet Spring! 🌼 Spring is a sweet-natured girl with a heart as soft as her gorgeous greyhound coat. She’s one of those dogs who makes life easier just by being around – relaxed, gentle, and incredibly easy to handle. Whether you’re an experienced dog owner or new to life with pups, Spring fits in effortlessly. She’s a real social butterfly, getting along brilliantly with all other dogs and loving the company of people. If you’ve got visitors, expect Spring to be first in line for a gentle hello and a little tail wag. She's a friendly soul who just wants to be included in the love. Spring would be a great fit for a family home, including one with respectful children. Her calm and steady personality makes her a safe and lovely companion for little ones. While she’s a joy in almost every way, Spring is still working on perfecting her lead manners – nothing too tricky, just a bit of ongoing training and consistency, and she’ll have it down in no time. If you're looking for a sweet, low-maintenance, and loving dog who enjoys companionship and will bring a peaceful energy to your home, Spring could be your perfect match.

NAME: Belle
TEXT: Belle is a happy, vibrant and energetic girl who is affectionate and social! She loves all the fun things in pet life - treats, zoomies, attention and play! She would love a fun active home to keep her stimulated and meet her training and enrichment needs. She is very friendly, and would suit a home with another dog big or small. She would suit kids experienced with large breed dogs. A fully fenced yard with somewhere for her to romp around and sunbake would be ideal for Belle! Available via Northern Rivers.

NAME: Gem
TEXT: Meet Gem 💎! This gorgeous girl has a heart full of love and a gentle, shy nature that takes a little time to come out of her shell. At first, Gem might feel a bit reserved as she gets used to new surroundings and people, but with patience and a calm environment, she quickly settles in and reveals her true, loving self. Gem would thrive best in a household where someone is usually around—whether working from home, part-time, or just a steady presence—so she never feels alone and can build her confidence at her own pace. One of Gem’s greatest joys is spending time with her doggy friends. She loves to play and interact with other dogs, showing her friendly and sociable side once she feels comfortable. Gem also adores children and enjoys their playful energy, making her a wonderful companion for families with kids who can engage her in gentle games and fun activities. Though she may start off a little shy, once Gem has warmed up to you, she’s a total cuddle queen. She loves curling up close, soaking in affection, and sharing those quiet, cozy moments that truly bond a dog and their human. Her sweet, gentle spirit shines through in these calm times, reminding you just how special she is. If you’re looking for a patient, loving, and devoted friend who will blossom beautifully in a supportive and caring home, Gem is waiting to meet you.
